However, no specific AMR genes or mutations were identified in the paper.
full_output.methodology: The study used microcosm biofilms and MIC passaging to assess the antimicrobial efficacy of antiseptics and bacterial adaptation.

full_output.paper_title: Study on risk factors, bacterial species, and drug resistance of acute pyelonephritis associated with ureteral stent after percutaneous nephrolithotomy.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified Escherichia coli, Klebsiella pneumoniae, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Enterococcus faecalis, and Staphylococcus epidermidis as the main pathogens causing acute pyelonephritis associated with ureteral stent after PCNL. It also highlighted the high resistance rates of these pathogens to quinolones (levofloxacin) and first- and second-generation cephalosporins.
full_output.methodology: Retrospective analysis of clinical data from 415 patients with indwelling ureteral stents after PCNL, including bacterial culture, identification, and drug sensitivity testing.

full_output.paper_title: Emergence of mcr-3 carrying Escherichia coli in Diseased Pigs in South Korea.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies mcr-3.1 and mcr-3.5 genes in colistin-resistant Escherichia coli isolates from diseased pigs in South Korea, highlighting the emergence of these variants in the pig industry.
full_output.methodology: PCR amplification, conjugation assay, whole-genome sequencing, and bioinformatics analysis.

full_output.paper_title: Rational design of a microbial consortium of mucosal sugar utilizers reduces Clostridiodes difficile colonization.

full_output.paper_title: Extracellular heme recycling and sharing across species by novel mycomembrane vesicles of a Gram-positive bacterium.

full_output.methodology: Proteomic analysis, genetic knockout and complementation, heme binding assays, and microscopy techniques were employed to characterize the role of mMVs in heme recycling and transport.

full_output.methodology: The study involved the design, synthesis, and evaluation of peptides for antimicrobial activity, including MIC testing, time-kill kinetics, and in vivo assessment in a murine model.

full_output.paper_title: In vitro Study of Bedaquiline Resistance in Mycobacterium tuberculosis Multi-Drug Resistant Clinical Isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Fighting Staphylococcus aureus infections with light and photoimmunoconjugates.

full_output.paper_title: High-throughput mapping of the phage resistance landscape in E. coli.

full_output.paper_title: High abundance of the colistin resistance gene mcr-1 in chicken gut-bacteria in Bangladesh.

Mutations in regulatory genes mexR, nalC, and nalD were found to drive this overexpression. Additionally, chromosomal mutations in gyrA, parC, and parE were linked to high-level fluoroquinolone resistance.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized RT-qPCR, whole-genome sequencing, and efflux pump inhibition assays to analyze the molecular mechanisms of antimicrobial and biocide resistance in P. aeruginosa isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Prevalence and Loads of Fecal Pollution Indicators and the Antibiotic Resistance Phenotypes of Escherichia coli in Raw Minced Beef in Lebanon.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified high prevalence of fecal coliforms and E. coli in raw minced beef in Lebanon, with 98% of samples exceeding fecal coliform limits and 76% exceeding E. coli limits. All E. coli isolates were resistant to at least one antibiotic, with 35% being multidrug-resistant. Resistance was observed to several antibiotics including penicillins, tetracyclines, quinolones, and others.
full_output.methodology: Disk diffusion assay was used to assess antimicrobial resistance of E. coli isolates from raw minced beef samples.
full_output.sample_size: 50 meat samples and 120 E. coli isolates

full_output.paper_title: Hospital Wastewater-Important Source of Multidrug Resistant Coliform Bacteria with ESBL-Production.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies several AMR genes, including bla TEM, bla CTX-M-2, bla CTX-M-8/25, tetA, and tetE, which are associated with multidrug resistance in coliform bacteria from hospital wastewater.
full_output.methodology: Multiplex PCR and susceptibility testing were used to identify AMR genes and resistance profiles in coliform isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Broadening and Enhancing Bacteriocins Activities by Association with Bioactive Substances.
full_output.key_findings: This review discusses the synergistic effects of bacteriocins when combined with bioactive substances such as antibiotics, phages, nanoparticles, and essential oils. It highlights the potential of these combinations to enhance antimicrobial activity, reduce the development of antibiotic resistance, and decrease the required concentrations of antimicrobial agents.
full_output.methodology: Review of literature on bacteriocins and their synergistic interactions with various bioactive substances.

full_output.paper_title: Evaluation of the Xpert Carba-R NxG Assay for Detection of Carbapenemase Genes in a Global Challenge Set of Pseudomonas aeruginosa Isolates.
full_output.key_findings: The Xpert Carba-R NxG assay effectively detects various carbapenemase genes, including blaVIM, blaIMP, blaNDM, blaSPM, blaKPC, and blaGES, in Pseudomonas aeruginosa isolates.
full_output.methodology: Genotypic testing using the Xpert Carba-R NxG and Carba-R assays.

full_output.paper_title: Mechanism of aminoacyl-tRNA acetylation by an aminoacyl-tRNA acetyltransferase AtaT from enterohemorrhagic E. coli.
full_output.key_findings: AtaT, a type-II toxin from enterohemorrhagic E. coli, acetylates the α-amino group of the aminoacyl-moiety of initiator Met-tRNAf Met, thereby inhibiting translation initiation. Additionally, AtaT efficiently acetylates Gly-tRNA Gly, Trp-tRNA Trp, Tyr-tRNA Tyr, and Phe-tRNA Phe isoacceptors, expanding its substrate specificity beyond Met-tRNAf Met.
full_output.methodology: Biochemical analysis, structural determination via X-ray crystallography, and in vivo/in vitro acetylation assays.

full_output.paper_title: Graphene Oxide affects Staphylococcus aureus and Pseudomonas aeruginosa dual species biofilm in Lubbock Chronic Wound Biofilm model.
full_output.key_findings: The study demonstrates that Graphene Oxide (GO) exhibits significant antibiofilm effects against Staphylococcus aureus PECHA 10 and Pseudomonas aeruginosa PECHA 4 in a dual-species biofilm model, reducing microbial growth and disrupting the fibrin network of the biofilm.
full_output.methodology: The study evaluated the effect of GO on biofilm formation and maturity using a chronic wound biofilm model, assessing microbial growth reduction, cell viability, and structural changes via SEM.

full_output.key_findings: The paper discusses various mechanisms of microbial resistance to antibiotics, including the role of genes like mecA and VanA in conferring resistance to beta-lactams and vancomycin, respectively.
full_output.methodology: The paper reviews the mechanisms of antibiotic resistance and the role of specific genes in resistance development.

full_output.paper_title: Development of Rifapentine-Loaded PLGA-Based Nanoparticles: In vitro Characterisation and in vivo Study in Mice.
full_output.key_findings: The study focused on the development and characterization of rifapentine-loaded PLGA-based nanoparticles for improved drug delivery, highlighting their potential in reducing dosing frequency and improving pharmacokinetic parameters.
full_output.methodology: The study involved the preparation and characterization of nanoparticles using techniques such as dynamic light scattering, transmission electron microscopy, and HPLC analysis.

full_output.paper_title: Clinical and Microbiological Prognostic Factors of in-Hospital Mortality Caused by Hypervirulent Klebsiella pneumoniae Infections: A Retrospective Study in a Tertiary Hospital in Southwestern China.

iroN.evidence_note: The paper mentions that iroN is a virulence factor and is associated with in-hospital mortality, but does not provide evidence that it confers resistance to antibiotics.

rmpA.evidence_note: The paper mentions that the rmpA gene showed an inverse association with in-hospital mortality (p=0.017).

full_output.key_findings: The study identified iroN and rmpA as significant prognostic factors for in-hospital mortality in patients with hypervirulent Klebsiella pneumoniae (hvKP) infections.
full_output.methodology: Retrospective analysis of clinical and microbiological data from hvKP-infected patients.

full_output.paper_title: Fluorescent Mesoporous Nanoparticles for β-Lactamase Screening Assays.
full_output.key_findings: The study presents a novel method for detecting β-lactamase activity in antibiotic-resistant bacteria using fluorescent mesoporous nanoparticles. The method involves the hydrolysis of penicillin G by β-lactamase, resulting in a pH change that quenches the fluorescence of the dye-doped nanoparticles.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized fluorescent mesoporous nanoparticles doped with FITC and loaded with penicillin G to detect β-lactamase activity. The method involved measuring pH changes and fluorescence quenching upon interaction with β-lactamase.

full_output.paper_title: Characterization of Antimicrobial Susceptibility, Extended-Spectrum β-Lactamase Genes and Phylogenetic Groups of Enteropathogenic Escherichia coli Isolated from Patients with Diarrhea.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified ESBL genes blaCTX-M9, blaSHV, blaOXA, and blaTEM in atypical EPEC isolates, with blaCTX-M9 being the most prevalent. High rates of resistance to ampicillin, trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole, and tetracycline were observed, along with multidrug resistance in 44.6% of isolates.
full_output.methodology: PCR, antimicrobial susceptibility testing, and phylogenetic analysis were used to characterize ESBL genes and resistance patterns in EPEC isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Identification of Novel Genes Involved in Escherichia coli Persistence to Tosufloxacin.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies 18 genes involved in E. coli persistence to tosufloxacin, including surA and lpcA, which show significant defects in persistence. These genes are periplasmic proteins and enzymes, and their mutants exhibit increased susceptibility to tosufloxacin and other stresses.
full_output.methodology: Genetic screen using the E. coli KEIO mutant library, complementation studies, and persistence assays under various stress conditions.

full_output.paper_title: Occurrence of Campylobacter spp. in Swedish calves, common sequence types and antibiotic resistance patterns.
full_output.key_findings: The study found that 46% of C. jejuni isolates were resistant to quinolones, with all isolates belonging to ST-19, ST-22, and ST-441 showing resistance to ciprofloxacin and nalidixic acid.
full_output.methodology: The study analyzed Campylobacter isolates from 154 calves using antimicrobial susceptibility testing and whole-genome sequencing to identify sequence types and resistance patterns.

full_output.paper_title: Dissemination of Verona Integron-encoded Metallo-β-lactamase among clinical and environmental Enterobacteriaceae isolates in Ontario, Canada.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies blaVIM-1 and blaVIM-2 as the primary metallo-beta-lactamase genes in clinical and environmental Enterobacteriaceae isolates in Ontario, Canada. Additionally, blaACC-1, blaCTX-M-15, and blaOXA-1 were found to contribute to antimicrobial resistance.
full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing, plasmid characterization, and antimicrobial susceptibility testing were used to identify and characterize AMR genes and mutations.

full_output.paper_title: Antibiotic sensitivity in correlation to the origin of secondary peritonitis: a single center analysis.
full_output.key_findings: The study highlights the importance of appropriate empiric antibiotic treatment for secondary peritonitis, showing that combinations like Meropenem/Vancomycin have high sensitivity rates (98%) against the prevalent pathogens, whereas Cephalosporin/Metronidazole combinations have lower efficacy (55-73%).
full_output.methodology: Retrospective analysis of 414 patients with secondary peritonitis, including microbiological cultures and antibiotic sensitivity testing.

full_output.paper_title: Contribution of Podoviridae and Myoviridae bacteriophages to the effectiveness of anti-staphylococcal therapeutic cocktails.
full_output.key_findings: The study isolated and characterized two bacteriophages, vB_SauM-515A1 (Myoviridae) and vB_SauP-436A1 (Podoviridae), which showed varying lytic activities against Staphylococcus aureus strains. The phage vB_SauP-436A1 had a narrower host range but could lyse strains resistant to vB_SauM-515A1 and the commercial cocktail.
full_output.methodology: Phage isolation, plaque assays, genome sequencing, and host range analysis.

full_output.paper_title: Genotyping of methicillin resistant Staphylococcus aureus from the United Arab Emirates.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified various methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) strains in the United Arab Emirates, including novel variants with resistance genes such as fusC, ermC, aacA-aphD, mupR, and cfr. These genes confer resistance to fusidic acid, erythromycin/clindamycin, gentamicin, mupirocin, and chloramphenicol/florfenicol/linezolid/tigecycline, respectively.
full_output.methodology: DNA microarray-based assays were used for the genotyping of MRSA isolates.

full_output.paper_title: High prevalence of mcr-1-encoded colistin resistance in commensal Escherichia coli from broiler chicken in Bangladesh.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified a high prevalence of the mcr-1 gene among commensal E. coli strains from broiler chickens in Bangladesh, indicating widespread colistin resistance.
full_output.methodology: Multiplex PCR, MIC determination, REP-PCR, and whole genome sequencing were used to analyze the prevalence and characteristics of mcr-1 in E. coli.

full_output.paper_title: Discovery of a Novel Natural Allosteric Inhibitor That Targets NDM-1 Against Escherichia coli.

blaNDM-1.mechanism: NDM-1 is a metallo-beta-lactamase that hydrolyzes beta-lactam antibiotics, including carbapenems and cephalosporins.
blaNDM-1.validation_method: enzyme inhibition assays, molecular dynamics simulation, and binding energy calculation

full_output.key_findings: Carnosic acid was identified as a novel natural allosteric inhibitor targeting NDM-1, which inhibits the activity of NDM-1 by binding to allosteric sites (Phe46, Tyr64, Leu65, Asp66, and Thr94) and altering the conformation of the active site, thereby reducing the catalytic activity of NDM-1.
full_output.methodology: Virtual screening, enzyme inhibition assays, molecular dynamics simulations, and fluorescence quenching experiments were used to identify and characterize the inhibitory effect of carnosic acid on NDM-1.

full_output.paper_title: Evaluating the Potential Antibiotic Resistance Status in Environment Based on the Trait of Microbial Community.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified several intrinsic antibiotic resistance genes (piARGs) in coastal sediments, including tetA, aacA, aacC, and aadK, which were associated with tetracycline and aminoglycoside resistance. These genes were found to be more abundant in Xiangshan Bay (XB) compared to other bays, suggesting a higher potential health risk due to long-term maricultural activities.
full_output.methodology: The study used 16S rRNA gene sequencing and predictive metagenomics to analyze the microbial community and predict intrinsic antibiotic resistance genes (piARGs).

full_output.paper_title: Shanghai Neisseria gonorrhoeae Isolates Exhibit Resistance to Extended-Spectrum Cephalosporins and Clonal Distribution.

mtrR.notes: MtrR mutations G45D and T86A are associated with ESC resistance.

gyrA.notes: GyrA substitutions S91F and D95A are associated with ciprofloxacin resistance.

parC.notes: ParC S88P substitution is associated with ciprofloxacin resistance.

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies penA substitutions A501T and G542S, porB1b G213S/Y, and 23S rRNA A2059G as key resistance mechanisms in Neisseria gonorrhoeae isolates from Shanghai, contributing to resistance against extended-spectrum cephalosporins and azithromycin.
full_output.methodology: Genotyping and MIC testing were used to characterize resistance mechanisms in N. gonorrhoeae isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Modulated Response of Aspergillus fumigatus and Stenotrophomonas maltophilia to Antimicrobial Agents in Polymicrobial Biofilm.
full_output.key_findings: The study shows that the presence of Stenotrophomonas maltophilia increases the susceptibility of Aspergillus fumigatus to amphotericin B, while Aspergillus fumigatus protects S. maltophilia from levofloxacin. The combination of amphotericin B with levofloxacin or rifampicin was effective in impairing the growth of both pathogens in polymicrobial biofilms.
full_output.methodology: The study used in vitro biofilm models, susceptibility testing, qPCR, and viable plate count to assess the antimicrobial response of A. fumigatus and S. maltophilia in mono- and polymicrobial biofilms.

full_output.paper_title: Antimicrobial resistance point-of-care testing for gonorrhoea treatment regimens: cost-effectiveness and impact on ceftriaxone use of five hypothetical strategies compared with standard care in England sexual health clinics.
full_output.key_findings: The study evaluates the cost-effectiveness of five hypothetical antimicrobial resistance point-of-care testing (AMR POCT) strategies for treating Neisseria gonorrhoeae, focusing on reducing ceftriaxone use. Strategy D, which uses a single AMR POCT for azithromycin resistance, was found to be the most cost-effective strategy for reducing ceftriaxone use while maintaining optimal treatment efficacy.
full_output.methodology: A decision tree model was used to simulate the cost-effectiveness of five AMR POCT strategies compared to standard care, incorporating data on antibiotic resistance prevalence, test sensitivity, and treatment outcomes.

full_output.paper_title: Comprehensive screening of genomic and metagenomic data reveals a large diversity of tetracycline resistance genes.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified 17 novel tetracycline resistance genes, including enzymatic degradation, ribosomal protection, and efflux pump genes, which conferred resistance in E. coli. These genes were found in various environments and showed potential for horizontal gene transfer.
full_output.methodology: Computational screening using fARGene, followed by experimental validation through cloning and MIC testing in E. coli.
full_output.sample_size: Large-scale genomic and metagenomic datasets from various sources.

full_output.paper_title: Geographically structured genomic diversity of non-human primate-infecting Treponema pallidum subsp. pertenue.
full_output.key_findings: The study analyzed the genomic diversity of Treponema pallidum subsp. pertenue in non-human primates and found no evidence for mutations that confer antimicrobial resistance.
full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing and phylogenetic analysis of Treponema pallidum subsp. pertenue isolates from non-human primates.
full_output.sample_size: Samples from 8 species in Taï National Park and 16 species from 11 other sites across sub-Saharan Africa

full_output.paper_title: Development of molecular assays for the rapid and cost-effective determination of fluoroquinolone, macrolide and lincosamide susceptibility of Mycoplasma synoviae isolates.
full_output.key_findings: The study developed molecular assays to detect resistance-associated mutations in Mycoplasma synoviae, focusing on fluoroquinolone, macrolide, and lincosamide resistance. Key mutations identified include those in parC, gyrA, gyrB, parE, rrl, and rplV genes.
full_output.methodology: Molecular assays (MAMAs) were developed to detect specific SNPs associated with antibiotic resistance in M. synoviae, validated through melt-MAMA analysis and comparison with MIC data.

full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing and bioinformatics analysis were used to identify and characterize the antibiotic resistance genes in the strain CC15031.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified various antimicrobial resistance genes in methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus pseudintermedius (MRSP) isolates, including blaZ, erm(B), erm(C), aph(3'), ant(6), aad(6), SAT-4, cat(pc221), dfr(G), tet(K), and tet(M). full_output.paper_title: Chitosan Inhibits Helicobacter pylori Growth and Urease Production and Prevents Its Infection of Human Gastric Carcinoma Cells.
full_output.key_findings: The study found that chitosan (DD95) inhibits the growth and urease production of Helicobacter pylori and reduces its adherence to human gastric carcinoma cells. It also enhances the antibacterial effects of antibiotics such as amoxicillin, tetracycline, and metronidazole.
full_output.methodology: The study used antibacterial tests, urease activity assays, and adherence experiments to evaluate the effects of chitosan on H. pylori.

full_output.paper_title: Plant Derived Natural Products against Pseudomonas aeruginosa and Staphylococcus aureus: Antibiofilm Activity and Molecular Mechanisms.
full_output.key_findings: The paper reviews the antibiofilm activity of plant-derived natural products against Pseudomonas aeruginosa and Staphylococcus aureus, focusing on their mechanisms of action, particularly through quorum sensing (QS) inhibition.
full_output.methodology: The paper provides a comprehensive review of the literature on the anti-biofilm effects of natural products, including their impact on QS systems and virulence factors.

full_output.paper_title: Evolution of Colistin Resistance in the Klebsiella pneumoniae Complex Follows Multiple Evolutionary Trajectories with Variable Effects on Fitness and Virulence Characteristics.

full_output.paper_title: Emergence of Resistance in Klebsiella aerogenes to Piperacillin-Tazobactam and Ceftriaxone.
full_output.key_findings: The study investigated the emergence of resistance in Klebsiella aerogenes to piperacillin-tazobactam (TZP) and ceftriaxone (CRO). It found that some TZP-susceptible isolates developed resistance when exposed to increasing concentrations of TZP and CRO, indicating the potential for resistance development under certain antibiotic exposure conditions.
full_output.methodology: The study used broth microdilution and Etest for MIC determination, serial passaging on agar plates, and time-kill studies to assess resistance emergence.

Resistance to multiple antibiotics including cefotaxime, ceftazidime, fosfomycin, and ciprofloxacin was observed.

The combination of these two mechanisms leads to full resistance.

full_output.methodology: Structural analysis, biochemical assays, and genetic complementation experiments were performed to investigate the role of SPOR proteins in PBP functionality.

full_output.paper_title: Presence of egc-positive major clones ST 45, 30 and 22 among methicillin-resistant and methicillin-susceptible oral Staphylococcus aureus strains.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified egc-positive major clones ST 45, 30, and 22 among methicillin-resistant and methicillin-susceptible oral Staphylococcus aureus strains, highlighting the presence of virulence factors such as enterotoxins and toxic shock syndrome toxin-1.
full_output.methodology: Antimicrobial susceptibility testing, spa typing, and PCR detection of toxin genes were used to characterize the isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Cytauxzoon felis cytochrome b gene mutation associated with atovaquone and azithromycin treatment.

full_output.methodology: Sequencing of the C. felis cytb gene before, during, and after treatment with atovaquone and azithromycin.

full_output.paper_title: Effects of Polyethyelene Glycol-Desferrioxamine:Gallium Conjugates on Pseudomonas aeruginosa Outer Membrane Permeability and Vancomycin Potentiation.
full_output.key_findings: The study investigates the effect of PEG-DG conjugates on enhancing the permeability of Pseudomonas aeruginosa's outer membrane, thereby potentiating the activity of vancomycin (VAN). It identifies that PEG-DG conjugates with molecular weights ≥2000 demonstrate synergistic activity with VAN against P. aeruginosa strains, but not against E. coli.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized antimicrobial efficacy assays, OM binding studies, and OM permeabilization experiments to evaluate the effects of PEG-DG conjugates on P. aeruginosa and E. coli.

full_output.paper_title: First Report of an Escherichia coli Strain Carrying the Colistin Resistance Determinant mcr-1 from a Dog in South Korea.

mcr-1.validation_method: PCR detection of the mcr-1 gene, conjugation assay, and MIC determination

full_output.key_findings: The study reports the first detection of the mcr-1 gene in colistin-resistant E. coli isolated from a dog in South Korea, highlighting the potential public health risk of mcr-1 dissemination through companion animals.
full_output.methodology: PCR, conjugation assay, MIC determination, PFGE, and comparative genomics analysis.

full_output.paper_title: Antibiotic resistance and typing of agr locus in Staphylococcus aureus isolated from clinical samples in Sanandaj, Western Iran.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified the presence of mecA, integrons, agrI, and agrIII in Staphylococcus aureus isolates, highlighting their roles in antibiotic resistance and susceptibility patterns.
full_output.methodology: Polymerase chain reaction (PCR) was used to detect the presence of mecA, integrons, SCCmec types, and agr types in S. aureus isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Restoring carbapenem efficacy: a novel carbapenem companion targeting metallo-β-lactamases in carbapenem-resistant Enterobacterales.
full_output.key_findings: The study describes the development of novel MBL inhibitors (MBLIs) that restore the efficacy of carbapenems against MBL-producing Enterobacterales. Compound 272 was particularly effective, reducing meropenem MICs by up to 128-fold and demonstrating potent inhibition of NDM, IMP, and VIM metallo-β-lactamases.
full_output.methodology: The study used susceptibility testing, time-killing assays, enzyme inhibition studies, and in vivo efficacy models to evaluate the MBLIs.

full_output.paper_title: Antimicrobial activities and mechanism of action of Cymbopogon khasianus (Munro ex Hackel) Bor essential oil.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified the antimicrobial potential of Cymbopogon khasianus essential oil (CKEO) against various human pathogens, demonstrating its effectiveness against both Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria, as well as Candida albicans. CKEO showed synergistic effects when combined with streptomycin against E. coli.
full_output.methodology: The antimicrobial activity of CKEO was assessed using microdilution assays, and synergistic interactions with antibiotics were evaluated using checkerboard microdilution tests.

full_output.paper_title: Antimicrobial Susceptibility Pattern and Associated Factors of Pediatric Septicemia in Southern Ethiopia.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified high rates of antimicrobial resistance among bacterial isolates from pediatric septicemia cases, with multidrug resistance observed in 82.1% of isolates. Gram-positive bacteria, particularly Staphylococcus aureus and coagulase-negative staphylococci, were the most common isolates.
full_output.methodology: Antimicrobial susceptibility testing was conducted using the Kirby-Bauer disc diffusion method.

full_output.key_findings: The paper discusses the antibacterial properties of honey, focusing on its mechanisms of action against bacteria, including structural and morphological changes, membrane potential alteration, cell cycle disruption, metabolic interference, efflux pump inhibition, quorum sensing disruption, and biofilm inhibition. full_output.methodology: The paper reviews existing literature and discusses various experimental studies on the antibacterial effects of honey, including microscopic analyses, genomic studies, and biochemical assays.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified multiple AMR genes in a multidrug-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae isolate from a Red Kangaroo, including beta-lactamases (bla DHA–3, bla SHV–1, bla CTX–M–14, bla TEM–191, bla TEM–1, bla CTX–M–3), aminoglycoside resistance genes (aph(3″)-Ib, aph(6)-Id, aac(3)-IIa, aac(6′)-Ib-cr, aadA16, arr-3), quinolone resistance genes (qnrS1, qnrB2), macrolide resistance gene (mphA), sulfonamide resistance genes (sul3, sul1), dihydrofolate reductase (dfrA3, dfrA27), chloramphenicol resistance gene (floR), tetracycline resistance genes (tetG, tetR), and multidrug efflux pump (qacEΔ1).

blaOXA-58.genetic_context: The genetic environment of bla OXA– 58 in pAb-C102_1 was comparable to that in pWA3 (accession number: JQ241791 ), with a similar genetic structure ( Figure 3B ). In both plasmids, the same IS Aba3 -like- ara C1- lys E structure was found downstream of bla OXA– 58 and the same three nucleotide substitutions were present in both IS Aba3 -like. The IS Aba3 -like- ara C1- lys E was followed by one IS 1006 -like copy (one nucleotide substitution compared to IS 1006 ) and the lys R gene. Upstream of bla OXA– 58 , a 427 bp truncated form of IS Aba3 was interrupted by a putative novel IS Ajo2 -like sequence. This contrasted with pWA3 in which a 121 bp truncated form of IS Aba3 is interrupted by IS 1008 . A Re27-2 region, which is a p dif site targeted by the XerC/XerD-like site-specific recombinases, was found 13 bp upstream of the IS Ajo2 -like sequence. A second copy of IS Ajo2 -like and IS 1006 -like (three nucleotide substitutions compared with IS 1006 ) was found upstream of the Re27-2 region. Neither a second copy of Re27-2 nor Re27-1 (single nucleotide variant of Re27-2) were found downstream of bla OXA– 58 .

full_output.key_findings: The study reports the emergence of the mcr-9.1 gene in a colistin-resistant Enterobacter kobei strain isolated from a critically endangered franciscana dolphin in Brazil, along with various other AMR genes.
full_output.methodology: Genomic analysis and antimicrobial susceptibility testing were conducted to identify AMR genes and resistance profiles.

full_output.paper_title: Molecular analysis of blaSHV, blaTEM, and blaCTX-M in extended-spectrum β-lactamase producing Enterobacteriaceae recovered from fecal specimens of animals.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified blaCTX-M, blaTEM, and blaSHV genes in ESBL-producing Enterobacteriaceae from animal fecal samples, highlighting their prevalence and distribution among different bacterial species.
full_output.methodology: PCR and sequencing were used to characterize blaCTX-M, blaTEM, and blaSHV genes in ESBL-producing Enterobacteriaceae.

full_output.paper_title: Acceleration of emergence of E. coli antibiotic resistance in a simulated sublethal concentration of copper and tetracycline co-contaminated environment.

mdtF.encodes: multidrug inner membrane transporter for the mdtEF-TolC efflux complex

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies mdtF and vanRI as genes involved in the development of resistance to polymyxin B and chloramphenicol in E. coli K12 under sublethal copper and tetracycline co-contaminated conditions.
full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing analysis of selected mutants to identify genetic changes associated with antibiotic resistance.

full_output.paper_title: A high prevalence of bla(OXA-48) in Klebsiella (Raoultella) ornithinolytica and related species in hospital wastewater in South West England.

blaOXA-48.validation_method: whole genome sequencing and plasmid analysis

full_output.key_findings: The study identified a high prevalence of the blaOXA-48 gene in Klebsiella (Raoultella) ornithinolytica and related species in hospital wastewater, highlighting the role of hospital wastewater as a reservoir for antibiotic-resistant Klebsiella.
full_output.methodology: Whole genome sequencing and plasmid analysis were used to characterize the resistance genes and plasmid distribution in the isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Structure and dynamics of the drug-bound bacterial transporter EmrE in lipid bilayers.
full_output.key_findings: The study presents the high-resolution structure of the drug-bound EmrE transporter in lipid bilayers, revealing the molecular mechanism of substrate recognition and transport. EmrE is identified as a multidrug resistance transporter that confers resistance through the efflux of polyaromatic cationic drugs.
full_output.methodology: The structure was determined using solid-state NMR spectroscopy, including 19F and 1H measurements, along with a fluorinated substrate, F4-TPP+.

full_output.paper_title: Different cellulosic polymers for synthesizing silver nanoparticles with antioxidant and antibacterial activities.
full_output.key_findings: The study investigated the use of cellulosic polymers as reducing and stabilizing agents for synthesizing silver nanoparticles (AgNPs) with antioxidant and antibacterial activities. AgNPs synthesized using ethylcellulose (EC) and hydroxypropyl methylcellulose (HPMC) exhibited significant antibacterial activity and lower minimum inhibitory concentrations (MIC) compared to other formulations.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized chemical reduction methods to synthesize AgNPs with various cellulosic polymers and evaluated their antioxidant and antibacterial activities through various analytical techniques including ICP-OES, TEM, and MIC assays.

full_output.paper_title: Predominant role of Haemophilus influenzae in the association of conjunctivitis, acute otitis media and acute bacterial paranasal sinusitis in children.
full_output.key_findings: The study highlights the high resistance rates of Haemophilus influenzae to ampicillin (80%) and amoxicillin-clavulanate (18%) in children with conjunctivitis, acute otitis media, and acute bacterial paranasal sinusitis.
full_output.methodology: The study analyzed bacterial cultures and antimicrobial susceptibility testing of Haemophilus influenzae isolates from children with the specified infections.

full_output.paper_title: Curbing gastrointestinal infections by defensin fragment modifications without harming commensal microbiota.
full_output.key_findings: The study presents Pam-3, a lipopeptide derived from a carboxyl-terminal fragment of human β-defensin 1, which exhibits potent antimicrobial activity against multidrug-resistant ESKAPE pathogens and effectively eradicates established biofilms without promoting resistance. It also shows selective reduction of gastrointestinal infections without disrupting the core microbiota.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized radial diffusion assays, broth microdilution assays, biofilm eradication assays, and in vivo mouse models to evaluate the antimicrobial activity and resistance profile of Pam-3.

full_output.paper_title: Analysis of virulence phenotypes and antibiotic resistance in clinical strains of Acinetobacter baumannii isolated in Nashville, Tennessee.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified multidrug-resistant (MDR) clinical strains of Acinetobacter baumannii with varying levels of resistance to several antibiotics, including ampicillin-sulbactam, amikacin, ceftriaxone, ceftazidime, cefotaxime, ciprofloxacin, cefepime, gentamicin, levofloxacin, meropenem, piperacillin, trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole, ticarcillin-K clavulanate, and tobramycin. Some strains showed high biofilm formation and motility, while others exhibited low levels of hemolysis.
full_output.methodology: The study analyzed 17 clinical isolates of A. baumannii for their antibiotic susceptibility, biofilm formation, motility, and hemolysis using standardized microbiological techniques and statistical analyses.

full_output.paper_title: Naringin inhibits the biofilms of metallo-β-lactamases (MβLs) producing Pseudomonas species isolated from camel meat.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified blaIMP as a metallo-beta-lactamase gene in Pseudomonas spp. isolated from camel meat, which confers resistance to carbapenems.
full_output.methodology: Detection of metallo-beta-lactamase production using disc potentiation assay and molecular characterization of isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Isolation of a Novel Lytic Bacteriophage against a Nosocomial Methicillin-Resistant Staphylococcus aureus Belonging to ST45.
full_output.key_findings: A novel lytic bacteriophage (R4) was isolated against a methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) strain belonging to ST45. The endolysin gene (orf27) was cloned, expressed, and shown to have lytic activity against the peptidoglycan of the host strain.
full_output.methodology: Phage isolation, genomic analysis, cloning, expression, and zymography were used to characterize the endolysin of R4 phage.

full_output.paper_title: CYP450 core involvement in multiple resistance strains of Aedes aegypti from French Guiana highlighted by proteomics, molecular and biochemical studies.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified CYP450 as a key player in metabolic resistance to deltamethrin in Aedes aegypti strains from French Guiana, alongside mutations in the sodium voltage-gated channel gene (V1016I and F1534C) associated with pyrethroid resistance.
full_output.methodology: Proteomic analysis, PCR genotyping, and biochemical assays were used to investigate resistance mechanisms in Aedes aegypti.
full_output.sample_size: Four isofemale strains (IR03, IR05, IR13, and NO)

full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes the distribution of ESBL genes, including bla CTX-M-1, bla CTX-M-14, bla CTX-M-15, bla CTX-M-27, bla SHV-12, and bla TEM-52, among ESBL-producing E. coli isolates from community faeces and clinical sources in the Netherlands.
full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing (WGS) and bioinformatic analysis using ResFinder and PopPUNK.

full_output.paper_title: Structure-Activity Relationship Modeling and Experimental Validation of the Imidazolium and Pyridinium Based Ionic Liquids as Potential Antibacterials of MDR Acinetobacter Baumannii and Staphylococcus Aureus.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies imidazolium and pyridinium based ionic liquids (ILs) as potential antibacterials against MDR Acinetobacter baumannii and Staphylococcus aureus. Compounds 3, 4, and 16 showed high antibacterial activity, potentially targeting the FabI enzyme involved in bacterial fatty acid biosynthesis.
full_output.methodology: QSAR modeling and biological testing were used to evaluate the antibacterial activity of ionic liquids against MDR strains.

full_output.paper_title: Enhanced Antimicrobial and Antibiofilm Effect of New Colistin-Loaded Human Albumin Nanoparticles.
full_output.key_findings: The study developed a novel colistin-loaded human albumin nanoparticle formulation (Col/haNPs) that showed enhanced antimicrobial and antibiofilm effects against multidrug-resistant (MDR) Gram-negative bacteria, including Acinetobacter baumannii and Klebsiella pneumoniae. Col/haNPs significantly reduced MIC values and inhibited biofilm formation compared to free colistin.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized a double-emulsion method to prepare Col/haNPs, characterized their physico-chemical properties, and evaluated their antimicrobial and antibiofilm activities using broth microdilution, biofilm formation assays, and growth kinetics.

full_output.paper_title: Homology analysis between clinically isolated extraintestinal and enteral Klebsiella pneumoniae among neonates.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified various beta-lactamase genes, including SHV, TEM-1, CTX-M-1, CTX-M-14, CTX-M-15, CMY-8, and NDM-1, which confer resistance to multiple antibiotics in Klebsiella pneumoniae isolates from neonates.
full_output.methodology: PCR and sequencing were used to identify beta-lactamase genes, and antibiotic susceptibility testing was conducted to determine resistance profiles.

full_output.paper_title: Analysis of Multidrug Resistance in Staphylococcus aureus with a Machine Learning-Generated Antibiogram.
full_output.key_findings: The study analyzed multidrug resistance (MDR) in Staphylococcus aureus using machine learning and association mining to identify resistance patterns and their associations. Key findings include the identification of common resistance patterns involving β-lactams, fluoroquinolones, macrolides, and lincosamides, highlighting the complex interactions and potential for resistance coselection during antimicrobial therapy.
full_output.methodology: Machine learning and association mining were used to analyze antimicrobial susceptibility testing data from 1,091 S. aureus isolates, identifying resistance patterns and their statistical associations.

full_output.paper_title: Pseudomonas aeruginosa OprF plays a role in resistance to macrophage clearance during acute infection.
full_output.key_findings: OprF plays a crucial role in P. aeruginosa virulence in a macrophage-dependent manner, protecting the bacterium against macrophage clearance by avoiding acidified phagosomes.
full_output.methodology: Zebrafish embryo model, macrophage depletion, confocal microscopy, and intracellular bacterial quantification.

full_output.paper_title: Antibiotic Treatment Regimes as a Driver of the Global Population Dynamics of a Major Gonorrhea Lineage.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies penA alleles, including 34.001, which confer reduced susceptibility to extended-spectrum cephalosporins (ESCs) in Neisseria gonorrhoeae ST-1901. Mutations in porB also contribute to ESC resistance.
full_output.methodology: Genomic analysis, MIC measurements, and phylogenetic studies were conducted to characterize AMR genes and mutations in N. gonorrhoeae ST-1901.

full_output.paper_title: 2-(2-Methyl-2-nitrovinyl)furan but Not Furvina Interfere with Staphylococcus aureus Agr Quorum-Sensing System and Potentiate the Action of Fusidic Acid against Biofilms.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies compound 2 as a potent quorum-sensing inhibitor (QSI) that interferes with the S. aureus Agr QS system and enhances the efficacy of fusidic acid against biofilms.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized molecular docking simulations, QS inhibition assays, and biofilm susceptibility tests to evaluate the effects of Furvina and 2-nitrovinylfuran derivatives on S. aureus.

full_output.paper_title: Streptococcus pyogenes Is Associated with Idiopathic Cutaneous Ulcers in Children on a Yaws-Endemic Island.

Streptococcus pyogenes.validation_method: relative abundance in IU specimens compared to other CU groups

full_output.key_findings: Streptococcus pyogenes was found to be enriched in idiopathic ulcers (IU) compared to other ulcer types and was associated with azithromycin treatment failure.
full_output.methodology: 16S rRNA gene sequencing, quantitative PCR, and statistical analysis of microbial communities.

full_output.paper_title: Comprehensive study of antimicrobial susceptibility pattern and extended spectrum beta-lactamase (ESBL) prevalence in bacteria isolated from urine samples.
full_output.key_findings: The study found that ESBL-producing bacteria, particularly E. coli and K. pneumoniae, were prevalent among uropathogens. ESBL producers showed higher resistance to various antibiotics compared to non-ESBL producers. Carbapenems and aminoglycosides were found to be the most effective treatments against these bacteria.
full_output.methodology: The study analyzed antimicrobial susceptibility of isolates using the disk diffusion method and identified ESBL producers via the Double Disc Synergy Test (DDST).

full_output.paper_title: First report on antibiotic resistance and antimicrobial activity of bacterial isolates from 13,000-year old cave ice core.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified antibiotic resistance in bacterial isolates from 13,000-year-old cave ice, highlighting the presence of multidrug-resistant (MDR), extended-drug-resistant (XDR), and pan-drug-resistant (PDR) strains, particularly in Proteobacteria and Bacteroidetes. Notably, Pseudomonas strains from the oldest ice layers exhibited PDR phenotypes.
full_output.methodology: The study analyzed 68 bacterial isolates from 13,000-year-old ice cores using antimicrobial susceptibility testing, 16S rRNA sequencing, and enzymatic activity assays.

full_output.paper_title: The antimicrobial capacity of Cistus salviifolius and Punica granatum plant extracts against clinical pathogens is related to their polyphenolic composition.
full_output.key_findings: The study evaluated the antimicrobial activity of Cistus salviifolius (CS) and Punica granatum (GP) extracts against Staphylococcus aureus isolates, revealing that CS extract was more effective against beta-lactam-resistant isolates, while GP extract was more effective against quinolone and oxacillin-sensitive isolates. The antimicrobial activity was linked to the polyphenolic composition of the extracts.
full_output.methodology: Antimicrobial activity was assessed using disk diffusion and microdilution methods, with HPLC-MS used for phenolic compound characterization.

full_output.paper_title: Pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics integration of danofloxacin against Eschrichia coli in piglet ileum ultrafiltration probe model.
full_output.key_findings: The study evaluated the pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics of danofloxacin (DAN) against Escherichia coli in a piglet ileum ultrafiltration probe model, determining the MIC, MBC, and MPC of DAN. It found that DAN's concentration in ileum ultrafiltrate was significantly higher than in plasma, and the PK/PD indices (AUC 24h /MIC and C max /MIC) were crucial for predicting antibacterial efficacy.
full_output.methodology: The study used ultrafiltration probes in piglets to collect ileum ultrafiltrate, measured DAN concentrations using HPLC, and determined PK/PD parameters. In vitro time-kill curves and MIC/MBC/MPC assessments were conducted to evaluate DAN's antibacterial effects.

full_output.paper_title: The Prevalence of Virulent and Multidrug-Resistant Enterococci in River Water and in Treated and Untreated Municipal and Hospital Wastewater.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified vancomycin resistance genes (vanA, vanB, vanC1, and vanC2/C3) in Enterococcus isolates from river water and wastewater, highlighting the prevalence of multidrug-resistant enterococci in these environments.
full_output.methodology: Culture-dependent methods, PCR, and susceptibility testing were used to identify and characterize Enterococcus isolates and their resistance mechanisms.

full_output.paper_title: The Occurrence of Antimicrobial-Resistant Salmonella enterica in Hatcheries and Dissemination in an Integrated Broiler Chicken Operation in Korea.

full_output.methodology: Antimicrobial susceptibility testing, PCR, sequencing, and PFGE analysis were used to characterize AMR genes and mutations.

full_output.paper_title: Randomized Controlled Trial of Oral Vancomycin Treatment in Clostridioides difficile-Colonized Patients.
full_output.key_findings: The study found that vancomycin treatment increased the abundance of macrolide-lincosamide-streptogramin (MLS) resistance genes and was associated with vancomycin-resistant enterococci (VRE) colonization and environmental contamination.
full_output.methodology: Double-blinded randomized controlled trial with metagenomic and genomic analysis of isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Gasdermin D restricts Burkholderia cenocepacia infection in vitro and in vivo.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies Gasdermin D (GSDMD) as a critical factor in restricting Burkholderia cenocepacia infection in both in vitro and in vivo settings. GSDMD contributes to the restriction of B. cenocepacia replication by promoting mitochondrial reactive oxygen species (mROS) production, which stimulates autophagy and limits bacterial proliferation. Additionally, GSDMD mediates the release of inflammatory cytokines, although its role in cell death is distinct from its antibacterial effects.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized genetic knockout models (gsdmd−/− and casp11−/− macrophages), Western blot analysis, flow cytometry, and in vivo infection models to investigate the role of GSDMD in B. cenocepacia infection.

full_output.paper_title: Identification of a predominant genotype of Mycobacterium tuberculosis in Brazilian indigenous population.

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies multiple mutations in drug resistance-associated genes, including katG, kasA, rpoB, and gyrA, which are linked to resistance against isoniazid, rifampicin, and fluoroquinolones in Mycobacterium tuberculosis isolates from the Guarani-Kaiowá population.
full_output.methodology: Whole genome sequencing and phylogenetic analysis were used to identify mutations in drug resistance-associated genes in Mycobacterium tuberculosis isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Draft Genome Sequences of Multidrug-Resistant and mcr-1.1-Harboring Escherichia coli Isolated from Drinking and Well Waters Used in Syrian Refugee Camps.
full_output.key_findings: Two multidrug-resistant Escherichia coli strains carrying the mcr-1.1 gene were identified in water sources from Syrian refugee camps, indicating potential spread of colistin resistance.
full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing and bioinformatics analysis of AMR genes.

full_output.key_findings: The study evaluated the effectiveness of antibiotic-loaded β-tricalcium phosphate/calcium sulfate (β-TCP/CS) beads against biofilms of Pseudomonas aeruginosa and Staphylococcus aureus, focusing on their antimicrobial potency and ability to prevent and kill biofilms in vitro.
full_output.methodology: In vitro assays including Kirby-Bauer tests, biofilm prevention and killing efficacy assessments, and statistical analysis of colony-forming unit (CFU) counts.

full_output.paper_title: An interbacterial DNA deaminase toxin directly mutagenizes surviving target populations.

DddA.validation_method: genomic DNA sequencing and fluorescence microscopy

SsdA.mechanism: deaminates cytosine in single-stranded DNA, leading to uracil formation and subsequent DNA damage
SsdA.validation_method: in vitro deamination assays and structural analysis

dddA.validation_method: expression in E. coli and P. aeruginosa, mutagenesis assays

full_output.key_findings: DddA and SsdA are deaminase toxins that induce mutagenesis in bacterial populations by deaminating cytosine in DNA, leading to C•G-to-T•A transitions. These toxins are part of the BaDTF2 and BaDTF3 subfamilies and exhibit distinct substrate preferences.
full_output.methodology: Genomic DNA sequencing, fluorescence microscopy, in vitro deamination assays, and structural analysis were used to characterize the mutagenic activity of DddA and SsdA.

full_output.paper_title: Identification of a conserved N-terminal domain in the first module of ACV synthetases.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies a conserved N-terminal domain (C* domain) in the first module of ACV synthetases from Nocardia lactamdurans and Penicillium rubens. This domain, although structurally related to condensation domains, lacks the typical active site motif and is essential for catalysis. Deletion of the C* domain in both organisms resulted in the inability to produce β-lactam antibiotics, indicating its critical role in the biosynthesis of penicillin.
full_output.methodology: Bioinformatic analysis, CRISPR/Cas9-mediated deletion, in vitro peptide formation assays, and HPLC/MS analysis were used to investigate the role of the C* domain in ACV synthetases.

full_output.paper_title: Discovery of beta-lactamase CMY-10 inhibitors for combination therapy against multi-drug resistant Enterobacteriaceae.

It also discovers non-beta-lactam compounds that inhibit CMY-10, enhancing the effectiveness of beta-lactam antibiotics.
full_output.methodology: Computational screening using SILCS technology, experimental validation through beta-lactamase activity assays, and susceptibility testing.

full_output.paper_title: Antimicrobial Resistance in Escherichia coli Strains Isolated from Humans and Pet Animals.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies several AMR genes in E. coli strains isolated from humans and pet animals, including blaTEM, qnrS1, qnrB1, blaCMY-2, blaCMY-59, tetA, tetB, sul1, sul2, and sul3, which confer resistance to various antibiotics such as beta-lactams, quinolones, tetracyclines, and sulfonamides.
full_output.methodology: Disk diffusion and minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) testing were used to determine antibiotic resistance profiles, and gene detection was performed through molecular techniques.

full_output.paper_title: Lactobacillus rhamnosus AD3 as a Promising Alternative for Probiotic Products.
full_output.key_findings: The study evaluated the probiotic properties of Lactobacillus strains, focusing on L. rhamnosus AD3, which exhibited superior resistance to low pH and bile salts, antimicrobial activity against urogenital pathogens, and strong adhesion to human cell lines. However, no AMR genes or mutations were identified in this study.
full_output.methodology: The study analyzed the antimicrobial activity, resistance to low pH and bile salts, biofilm formation, hydrogen peroxide production, and adhesion capabilities of Lactobacillus strains using various microbiological techniques.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified antibiotic resistance gene families enriched in Arctic waste stabilization ponds, including macrolide resistance, class A beta-lactamases, ABC-F ribosomal protection, and rRNA methyl transferases.
full_output.methodology: 16S rRNA gene and metagenome sequencing were used to characterize microbial communities and antibiotic resistance genes in waste stabilization ponds and receiving waters.

full_output.methodology: Retrospective cohort study analyzing clinical data, antimicrobial susceptibility, and risk factors for mortality in CR-GNB infections among abdominal solid organ transplant recipients.

full_output.methodology: The study used disc diffusion, microdilution, Griess, ELISA, MTT, DPPH, and ABTS assays to evaluate the antibacterial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities of the extracts.

full_output.paper_title: Trends in microbiological profiles and antibiotic resistance in periprosthetic joint infections.
full_output.key_findings: The study found an increase in methicillin-resistant coagulase-negative Staphylococcus (MR-CoNS) and levofloxacin-resistant CoNS and Staphylococcus aureus, while penicillin-resistant CoNS and S. aureus decreased.
full_output.methodology: Retrospective analysis of 231 patients with periprosthetic joint infections, analyzing microbial distribution and antibiotic resistance patterns.

full_output.paper_title: Molecular characterization of mutations associated with resistance to second line drugs in Mycobacterium tuberculosis patients from Casablanca, Morocco.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified mutations in gyrA, gyrB, rrs, and tlyA genes associated with resistance to second-line drugs in Mycobacterium tuberculosis isolates from Casablanca, Morocco. Specifically, Ala90Val in gyrA, Asp472His and Asp472Asn in gyrB, A1401G in rrs, and Lys89Glu in tlyA were found to confer resistance to Ofloxacin, Amikacin, Kanamycin, and Capreomycin, respectively.
full_output.methodology: The study involved drug susceptibility testing, PCR amplification, and DNA sequencing of target genes in MDR-TB isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Antimicrobial and antibiofilm potentials of cinnamon oil and silver nanoparticles against Streptococcus agalactiae isolated from bovine mastitis: new avenues for countering resistance.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified the antimicrobial and antibiofilm potential of cinnamon oil and silver nanoparticles against multidrug-resistant Streptococcus agalactiae isolates from bovine mastitis. It also found that S. agalactiae isolates express virulence genes (hyl, cylE, scpB, and lmb) and form biofilms.
full_output.methodology: The study used antimicrobial susceptibility testing, molecular identification through PCR, and biofilm formation assays to evaluate the effectiveness of cinnamon oil and silver nanoparticles against S. agalactiae isolates.

full_output.key_findings: The OmiX-AMP pathogen test successfully detected carbapenem resistance markers NDM and OXA-48 in various bacterial pathogens, including E. coli, K. pneumoniae, A. baumannii, and P. aeruginosa.
full_output.methodology: The study evaluated the OmiX-AMP pathogen test for detecting microbial identification and antimicrobial resistance in blood using isothermal amplification techniques.

full_output.paper_title: N(α)-1, 3-Benzenedicarbonyl-Bis-(Amino Acid) and Dipeptide Candidates: Synthesis, Cytotoxic, Antimicrobial and Molecular Docking Investigation.
full_output.key_findings: The study focused on synthesizing various peptides and evaluating their antimicrobial and anticancer activities. Among the synthesized compounds, peptide 4 showed potent antimicrobial activity, while peptide 8 exhibited the highest antifungal activity against Aspergillus niger. Compounds 6 and 7 displayed significant cytotoxicity against breast cancer cells. However, none of the compounds were found to possess antimicrobial resistance (AMR) genes or mutations.
full_output.methodology: The study involved the synthesis of peptides and their evaluation for antimicrobial and anticancer activities using well diffusion assays, MTT assays, and molecular docking studies.

full_output.paper_title: Correlation Between Biofilm-Formation and the Antibiotic Resistant Phenotype in Staphylococcus aureus Isolates: A Laboratory-Based Study in Hungary and a Review of the Literature.
full_output.key_findings: The study found that biofilm-producing S. aureus isolates were more commonly resistant to erythromycin, clindamycin, and rifampin. No significant association was found between methicillin-resistance and biofilm-production.
full_output.methodology: The study used phenotypic tests, including the crystal violet tube-adherence assay and Congo red agar method, to assess biofilm formation and antimicrobial susceptibility testing to determine resistance profiles.

full_output.paper_title: Chemical Composition, Antioxidant, Antimicrobial, and Phytotoxic Potential of Eucalyptus grandis × E. urophylla Leaves Essential Oils.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified the chemical composition of Eucalyptus grandis × E. urophylla essential oil (EEO) and evaluated its antioxidant, antimicrobial, and phytotoxic potential. Key components included α-pinene, α-terpineol, aromadendrene, d-limonene, and endo-borneol. EEO exhibited strong antibacterial and antifungal activity against various pathogens, including Salmonella typhimurium and Colletotrichum gloeosporioides. It also showed significant phytotoxic effects on plant seeds.
full_output.methodology: The essential oil was extracted via steam distillation and analyzed using GC-MS. Antioxidant activity was assessed using DPPH and ABTS assays. Antimicrobial activity was evaluated through agar diffusion and MIC/MBC tests. Antifungal and phytotoxic activities were determined using growth rate and seed germination assays.

full_output.methodology: The study assessed the antibacterial activity of myricetin, its effect on H. pylori morphological transformation, biofilm formation, and synergy with antibiotics using MIC/MBC assays, fluorescence microscopy, and qPCR.

full_output.paper_title: First Case of Staphylococi Carrying Linezolid Resistance Genes from Laryngological Infections in Poland.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies the first case of staphylococci carrying linezolid resistance genes from patients with chronic sinusitis in Poland. Linezolid resistance in S. aureus was associated with mutations in the ribosomal proteins L3 and L4, while in S. haemolyticus, resistance was associated with the presence of the cfr gene. Additionally, the S. aureus strain harbored optrA and poxtA genes.
full_output.methodology: PCR, sequencing, and antimicrobial susceptibility testing were used to identify and characterize the resistance genes and mutations.

full_output.paper_title: Lantibiotics Produced by Oral Inhabitants as a Trigger for Dysbiosis of Human Intestinal Microbiota.
full_output.key_findings: Lantibiotics produced by oral inhabitants, such as Mutacin I, Mutacin III, and Smb, have antimicrobial activity against Gram-positive bacteria in the intestinal microbiota, leading to a decrease in Firmicutes abundance and potential dysbiosis.
full_output.methodology: Susceptibility assays, 16S rRNA gene sequencing, and quantitative real-time PCR were used to analyze the impact of lantibiotics on the intestinal microbiota.

full_output.paper_title: The Intestinal Carriage of Plasmid-Mediated Colistin-Resistant Enterobacteriaceae in Tertiary Care Settings.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies the mcr-1.1 gene as a plasmid-mediated colistin resistance gene in E. coli isolates, with the gene localized on IncX4 and IncHI2 plasmids. One isolate exhibited inducible colistin resistance due to the excision of the IS2 element from the mcr-1 promoter region.
full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing, qPCR, broth microdilution, and lateral flow immunoassay were used to identify and validate the mcr-1.1 gene and its resistance mechanism.

full_output.paper_title: Antibiotics as a Stressing Factor Triggering the Harboring of Helicobacter pylori J99 within Candida albicans ATCC10231.
full_output.key_findings: The study found that amoxicillin increases the internalization of Helicobacter pylori J99 into Candida albicans ATCC10231, whereas clarithromycin does not. This internalization was confirmed through PCR detection of the 16S rDNA gene of H. pylori in total C. albicans DNA.
full_output.methodology: The study used co-culturing of H. pylori J99 and C. albicans ATCC10231 in the presence of subinhibitory concentrations of amoxicillin and clarithromycin, followed by microscopic observation and PCR confirmation of H. pylori internalization.

full_output.paper_title: SCRaMbLE: A Study of Its Robustness and Challenges through Enhancement of Hygromycin B Resistance in a Semi-Synthetic Yeast.

full_output.methodology: SCRaMbLE was used to generate structural variations in a semi-synthetic yeast strain, followed by nanopore sequencing and spot tests to assess hygromycin B resistance.

full_output.paper_title: Detection of a New Resistance-Mediating Plasmid Chimera in a bla(OXA-48)-Positive Klebsiella pneumoniae Strain at a German University Hospital.

full_output.methodology: Antibiogram profiling using the Kirby-Bauer disk diffusion method and molecular characterization via PCR and sequencing.

full_output.paper_title: Isolation and detection of antibiotics resistance genes of Escherichia coli from broiler farms in Sukabumi, Indonesia.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified four antibiotic resistance genes in Escherichia coli isolates from broiler farms in Sukabumi, Indonesia: tetA, blaTEM, gyrA, and ermB. These genes conferred resistance to tetracycline, oxytetracycline, ampicillin, nalidixic acid, ciprofloxacin, enrofloxacin, and erythromycin.
full_output.methodology: PCR, antibiotic sensitivity testing, and statistical analysis.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified class I and II integrons and the qacE gene in multidrug-resistant MRSA isolates from Egypt, highlighting their association with reduced susceptibility to biocides and antibiotics.
full_output.methodology: PCR and antimicrobial susceptibility testing were used to detect integrons and assess resistance profiles.

full_output.key_findings: The study isolated antibiotic-resistant actinomycetes from river sediments, focusing on those resistant to azithromycin and meropenem, which exhibited antibacterial activity against various test bacteria.
full_output.methodology: Resistance-guided isolation of actinomycetes from river sediments using antibiotic-supplemented media followed by biochemical and 16S rDNA sequencing for identification.

full_output.paper_title: Characterization of TMexCD3-TOprJ3, an RND-Type Efflux System Conferring Resistance to Tigecycline in Proteus mirabilis, and Its Associated Integrative Conjugative Element.

The gene cluster was found on an SXT/R391 integrative conjugative element (ICE) and was shown to increase tigecycline MICs when expressed in E. coli DH5alpha.
full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing, cloning, and antimicrobial susceptibility testing were used to characterize the tmexCD3-toprJ3 gene cluster and its role in tigecycline resistance.

full_output.paper_title: Inhibition of Escherichia coli Lipoprotein Diacylglyceryl Transferase Is Insensitive to Resistance Caused by Deletion of Braun's Lipoprotein.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies G2824 as the first-described inhibitor of Lgt, which potently inhibits Lgt biochemical activity in vitro and is bactericidal against wild-type Acinetobacter baumannii and E. coli strains. full_output.methodology: The study used genetic depletion, chemical inhibition, and biochemical assays to investigate the role of Lgt in bacterial growth and resistance mechanisms.

full_output.paper_title: In silico drug repurposing for filarial infection predicts nilotinib and paritaprevir as potential inhibitors of the Wolbachia 5'-aminolevulinic acid synthase.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies nilotinib and paritaprevir as potential inhibitors of the Wolbachia 5'-aminolevulinic acid synthase (wALAS) through in silico drug repurposing, molecular docking, and MM-PBSA analysis.
full_output.methodology: In silico drug repurposing, molecular docking, MM-PBSA analysis, and molecular dynamics simulations were used to identify and validate potential inhibitors of wALAS.

full_output.paper_title: Emergence of oxacillinase-181 carbapenemase-producing diarrheagenic Escherichia coli in Ghana.

full_output.paper_title: Prevalence, Clinical Characteristics and Changes of Antibiotic Resistance in Children with Nontyphoidal Salmonella Infections from 2009-2018 in Chongqing, China.
full_output.key_findings: The study found that antibiotic resistance rates in NTS infections in children in Chongqing remained high, with significant increases in resistance to certain antibiotics like cefazolin, cefotaxime, ciprofloxacin, and levofloxacin, while others like piperacillin-tazobactam and ceftazidime showed decreases. Multi-drug resistance (MDR) was detected in 13.7% of cases.
full_output.methodology: Retrospective analysis of 501 NTS isolates from children with infections, including antibiotic susceptibility testing via Kirby-Bauer disk diffusion method.

full_output.paper_title: A Modular Synthetic Route Involving N-Aryl-2-nitrosoaniline Intermediates Leads to a New Series of 3-Substituted Halogenated Phenazine Antibacterial Agents.
full_output.key_findings: The study reports a new series of 3-substituted halogenated phenazines (HPs) with potent antibacterial and biofilm-killing activities against various Gram-positive pathogens, including methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA), vancomycin-resistant Enterococcus faecium (VRE), and Mycobacterium tuberculosis. HP 29 showed exceptional activity against MRSA and other resistant strains, inducing iron starvation in biofilms and demonstrating efficacy in in vivo wound infection models.
full_output.methodology: Synthesis of HPs, in vitro antibacterial assays, biofilm eradication assays, and in vivo wound infection models in mice.

full_output.paper_title: Phenotypic and Genotypic Antibiotic Resistant diarrheagenic Escherichia coli pathotypes isolated from Children with Diarrhea in Nairobi City, Kenya.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified several antibiotic resistance genes in diarrheagenic Escherichia coli isolates from children in Nairobi, Kenya, including citm, bla CMY, aadA1, aac(3)-IV, qnr, catA1, ere(A), and tet(A), which confer resistance to ampicillin, ceftriaxone, streptomycin, gentamycin, ciprofloxacin, chloramphenicol, erythromycin, and tetracycline, respectively.
full_output.methodology: The study used PCR and phenotypic resistance testing to identify antibiotic resistance genes in diarrheagenic Escherichia coli isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Predicting rifampicin resistance mutations in bacterial RNA polymerase subunit beta based on majority consensus.

full_output.paper_title: Comparison of PCR and phenotypic methods for the detection of methicillin resistant Staphylococcus aureus.

full_output.key_findings: The study compared PCR and phenotypic methods for detecting methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) and found that PCR detected the mecA gene in 72% of isolates, serving as the gold standard. Cefoxitin disc diffusion and Vitek-2 showed high sensitivity and specificity, while CHROM agar had high sensitivity but lower specificity.
full_output.methodology: PCR, cefoxitin disc diffusion, CHROM agar, and Vitek-2 susceptibility testing were used to detect MRSA.

full_output.paper_title: Global prevalence and molecular characterization of extended-spectrum β-lactamase producing-Escherichia coli in dogs and cats - A scoping review and meta-analysis.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies various ESBL genes, including bla CTX-M, bla SHV, and bla TEM, in E. coli isolates from dogs and cats globally, highlighting their prevalence and distribution across different regions.
full_output.methodology: The study conducted a scoping review and meta-analysis of published studies to assess the prevalence and molecular characteristics of ESBL-producing E. coli in companion animals.

full_output.paper_title: Comparative activity of plazomicin against extended-spectrum cephalosporin-resistant Escherichia coli clinical isolates (2012-2017) in relation to phylogenetic background, sequence type 131 subclones, bla(CTX-M) genotype, and resistance to comparator agents.
full_output.key_findings: Plazomicin showed high susceptibility against extended-spectrum cephalosporin-resistant Escherichia coli isolates, with the only notable variation in MICs related to ST131 subclone status, particularly the C1-M27 subclone. No specific AMR genes or mutations were experimentally validated in this study.
full_output.methodology: Broth microdilution MIC determinations were performed for plazomicin and 11 comparator agents against 216 ESCREC isolates, with statistical analysis of MIC variations in relation to bacterial characteristics.

full_output.paper_title: Discovery of anti-infective adipostatins through bioactivity-guided isolation and heterologous expression of a type III polyketide synthase.

full_output.paper_title: Analysis of Genome Sequences of Coagulase-Negative Staphylococci Isolates from South Africa and Nigeria Highlighted Environmentally Driven Heterogeneity.

Other genes like blaZ, FosB, mecA, FusF, dfrG, ErmA, ErmB, Erm(43), and mphC were also characterized.

full_output.paper_title: Genomics-guided identification of a conserved CptBA-like toxin-antitoxin system in Acinetobacter baumannii.

full_output.methodology: In silico analysis, plasmid construction, and expression in E. coli with growth and transcriptional analysis.

full_output.paper_title: The Pharmacodynamics Study of Insect Defensin DLP4 Against Toxigenic Staphylococcus hyicus ACCC 61734 in Vitro and Vivo.

full_output.paper_title: Prevalence, virulence factor and antimicrobial resistance analysis of Salmonella Enteritidis from poultry and egg samples in Iran.

full_output.paper_title: Antibiofilm and antivirulence potential of silver nanoparticles against multidrug-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii.

full_output.methodology: The study employed a green synthesis approach using fungal metabolites, followed by characterization techniques such as UV-Vis, XRD, TEM, DLS, EDX, FT-IR, and XPS, along with antimicrobial and larvicidal assays.

full_output.paper_title: Involvement of a Multidrug Efflux Pump and Alterations in Cell Surface Structure in the Synergistic Antifungal Activity of Nagilactone E and Anethole against Budding Yeast Saccharomyces cerevisiae.

PDR5.mechanism: mediates resistance to nagilactone E by efflux

full_output.key_findings: The study identified PDR5 as a multidrug efflux pump involved in resistance to nagilactone E in Saccharomyces cerevisiae. The combination of nagilactone E and anethole showed synergistic antifungal activity by inhibiting PDR5 transcription and reducing efflux of nagilactone E.
full_output.methodology: Susceptibility assays, RT-qPCR, fluorescence microscopy, and electron microscopy were used to investigate the role of PDR5 in resistance to nagilactone E and the synergistic effects of anethole.

full_output.paper_title: Strategies to Tackle Antimicrobial Resistance: The Example of Escherichia coli and Pseudomonas aeruginosa.
full_output.key_findings: This review discusses strategies to combat antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in Escherichia coli and Pseudomonas aeruginosa, highlighting the potential of vaccines and monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) as alternatives to traditional antibiotics. It emphasizes the challenges in developing effective vaccines and mAbs against these AMR pathogens.
full_output.methodology: This is a review article summarizing current research and developments in vaccines and mAbs for combating AMR in E. coli and P. aeruginosa.

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies various antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs) in livestock and poultry manure, highlighting the prevalence of sulfonamide (sul1, sul2), tetracycline (tetA, tetB2), and beta-lactam resistance genes in environmental samples.
full_output.methodology: Environmental sampling and detection of ARGs in water, soil, and plants.

full_output.paper_title: Lessons Learned from an Experience with Vancomycin-Intermediate Staphylococcus aureus Outbreak in a Newly Built Secondary Hospital in Korea.
full_output.key_findings: The study describes a vancomycin-intermediate Staphylococcus aureus (VISA) outbreak in an ICU of a newly built hospital in South Korea, highlighting the importance of early detection and contact screening for controlling the spread of VISA.
full_output.methodology: The study analyzed clinical and microbiological characteristics of VISA isolates, performed antimicrobial susceptibility testing, and conducted molecular typing to determine the relatedness of the isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Multidrug-Resistant Campylobacter jejuni on Swine Processing at a Slaughterhouse in Eastern Spain.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified that 96.3% of C. jejuni isolates were multidrug-resistant, showing resistance to multiple antibiotics including ciprofloxacin, tetracycline, nalidixic acid, ampicillin, and streptomycin.
full_output.methodology: The study conducted antimicrobial susceptibility testing using disc diffusion assays on C. jejuni isolates obtained from swine processing at a slaughterhouse.

full_output.paper_title: Prevalence and Antimicrobial Resistances of Salmonella spp. Isolated from Wild Boars in Liguria Region, Italy.
full_output.key_findings: The study found that 94.6% of the isolated Salmonella spp. strains were resistant to at least one antimicrobial, with the highest resistance observed against sulfonamides. Specific resistance profiles were noted for various serotypes, including S. Typhimurium monophasic variant and S. Coeln.
full_output.methodology: The study involved the isolation and typing of Salmonella spp. from wild boar livers, followed by antimicrobial susceptibility testing using the Kirby-Bauer disk diffusion method.

full_output.paper_title: Prenylated Flavonoids with Potential Antimicrobial Activity: Synthesis, Biological Activity, and In Silico Study.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified prenylated flavonoids 11, 12, and 13 as having strong antibacterial activity against MRSA, with synergistic effects when combined with antibiotics like vancomycin, ciprofloxacin, and methicillin. Additionally, compounds 11 and 12 showed significant reduction in ROS levels generated by ciprofloxacin, suggesting a potential mechanism of action.
full_output.methodology: Synthesis of prenylated flavonoids, in vitro antibacterial and antifungal assays, MIC and MFC determinations, and molecular docking studies.

full_output.paper_title: Antimicrobial Activity of Cyclic-Monomeric and Dimeric Derivatives of the Snail-Derived Peptide Cm-p5 against Viral and Multidrug-Resistant Bacterial Strains.
full_output.key_findings: The study evaluates the antimicrobial activity of cyclic-monomeric and dimeric derivatives of the snail-derived peptide Cm-p5 against multidrug-resistant bacterial strains and viruses. The derivatives showed varying levels of activity, with some demonstrating notable efficacy against specific pathogens.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized agar overlay assays, minimal inhibitory concentration (MIC) determinations, and antiviral assays to evaluate the antimicrobial properties of Cm-p5 derivatives.

full_output.paper_title: Microbial Contamination in Hospital Environment Has the Potential to Colonize Preterm Newborns' Nasal Cavities.
full_output.key_findings: The study found that environmental microorganisms, including those with resistance genes, were detected in the nasal swabs of preterm newborns after hospitalization, indicating potential transmission from hospital surfaces.
full_output.methodology: The study used NGS and qPCR microarray analyses to characterize the bacterial composition and resistome of nasal swabs from preterm newborns and environmental surfaces.

full_output.paper_title: Prevalence of Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR) Salmonella spp. and Escherichia coli Isolated from Broilers in the East Coast of Peninsular Malaysia.
full_output.key_findings: The study found high prevalence of antimicrobial resistance in Salmonella spp. and E. coli isolated from broilers in the East Coast of Peninsular Malaysia, with multidrug resistance observed in 82% of Salmonella spp. and 100% of E. coli. Resistance was particularly prevalent towards tetracycline, chloramphenicol, and erythromycin.
full_output.methodology: Antimicrobial susceptibility testing was performed using the disc diffusion method, and multiple antimicrobial resistance (MAR) indices were calculated.

full_output.paper_title: The SCCmec Types and Antimicrobial Resistance among Methicillin-Resistant Staphylococcus Species Isolated from Dogs with Superficial Pyoderma.

mecA.mechanism: confers resistance to beta-lactam antibiotics by altering the target site
