rpoB.notes: Mutations in rpoB were associated with cross-resistance to daptomycin in vancomycin-resistant Enterococcus faecium.

full_output.key_findings: Rifaximin use in patients with cirrhosis and hepatic encephalopathy was associated with increased antimicrobial resistance, particularly vancomycin resistance and multidrug resistance.
full_output.methodology: Multinational retrospective cohort study with propensity score matching to evaluate the association between rifaximin use and antimicrobial resistance.

full_output.paper_title: Various Bacillus and Paenibacillus Spp. Isolated From Soil Produce Compounds With Potent Antimicrobial Activity Against Clinically Relevant Pathogens.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified several Bacillus and Paenibacillus strains, particularly Paenibacillus profundus strains 7.5 and M4.5, that produce compounds with potent antimicrobial activity against multidrug-resistant pathogens, including carbapenem-resistant Enterobacterales (CRE). Genome mining revealed biosynthetic gene clusters associated with antimicrobial production, including clusters similar to known compounds like polymyxin B, paenilan, colistin, and paenibacterin.
full_output.methodology: The study used 16S rRNA sequencing for taxonomic identification, antiSMASH for genome mining, and antimicrobial assays to evaluate the activity of isolated strains against various pathogens.

full_output.paper_title: Docosahexaenoic Acid-Driven Metabolic Reprogramming as an Attractive Anti-Infection Strategy to Potentiate β-Lactam Antibiotic Efficacy.
full_output.key_findings: DHA inhibits β-lactamase activity, enhancing the efficacy of β-lactam antibiotics against MRSA.
full_output.methodology: Checkerboard assay, molecular dynamics simulations, and measurement of β-lactamase activity.

full_output.paper_title: Evaluation of resistance modulation in MDR Pseudomonas aeruginosa and Klebsiella pneumoniae using peppermint oil nanoemulsion: integrating antibacterial assays and molecular modeling.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified caryophyllene as a compound with high binding affinity against β-lactamase enzymes from K. pneumoniae (4EXY) and P. aeruginosa (6R73), suggesting potential for resistance modulation.
full_output.methodology: Antibacterial assays, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulations were used to evaluate the effectiveness of peppermint oil nanoemulsion against multidrug-resistant isolates.
full_output.sample_size: Twenty clinical isolates, comprising ten K. pneumoniae and ten P. aeruginosa.

full_output.paper_title: Novel integrated approach modeling proanthocyanidins and bacteriophages to combat multidrug Salmonella Typhimurium in challenged broilers.

organisms_tested_in: Salmonella enterica subsp. enterica serovar Typhimurium
Salmonella enterica subsp. enterica serovar Typhimurium

full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes the virulence genes spvC and sopE in Salmonella Typhimurium, showing their role in the pathogenicity of the bacterium.
full_output.methodology: The study used qPCR to analyze gene expression of virulence factors in Salmonella Typhimurium.

full_output.paper_title: Resistance evolution under potentiated sulphonamide pressure in Escherichia coli.

emrR.encodes: repressor of emrAB multidrug efflux pump

full_output.key_findings: The study identified multiple antimicrobial resistance genes and mutations in E. coli under potentiated sulphonamide pressure, highlighting the role of efflux pumps and folate pathway modifications in resistance development.
full_output.methodology: Next-generation sequencing and MIC testing were used to analyze resistance mechanisms in E. coli exposed to increasing concentrations of potentiated sulphonamide.
full_output.sample_size: Three biological replicates were performed for each antibiotic concentration.

full_output.paper_title: Serotype distribution and antimicrobial resistance of Streptococcus pneumoniae in paediatric patients in Japan (2020-2023).
full_output.key_findings: The study identified high resistance rates to erythromycin, penicillin, cefotaxime, and meropenem among Streptococcus pneumoniae isolates from pediatric patients in Japan. Key resistance genes included ermB, mefE, and tetM.
full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing, antimicrobial susceptibility testing, and serotyping were used to analyze the isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Overcoming Antimicrobial Resistance in Bacterial Keratitis With an Antibiotic-Eluting Contact Lens.
full_output.key_findings: The study developed a novel antibiotic-eluting contact lens (M-TCL) that delivers sustained, high concentrations of moxifloxacin to treat drug-resistant bacterial keratitis. The M-TCL demonstrated superior pharmacokinetic profiles and efficacy against methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) in a rabbit model.
full_output.methodology: The study evaluated the pharmacokinetics and efficacy of the M-TCL in a rabbit model of MRSA keratitis, comparing it to conventional moxifloxacin eye drops.
full_output.sample_size: n=6 per time point per treatment

full_output.paper_title: Clinical evaluation of a commercial culture-free targeted next-generation sequencing test for diagnosis of drug-resistant tuberculosis.
full_output.key_findings: The study evaluates the ABL DeepChek 13-Plex KB Drug Susceptibility Testing assay for detecting drug-resistant tuberculosis using targeted next-generation sequencing. It shows high sensitivity and specificity for several anti-TB drugs, though challenges with sample failure rates and lower sensitivity for certain drugs like ethambutol are noted.
full_output.methodology: The study used a multicenter approach to evaluate the ABL tNGS workflow, comparing it against composite reference standards including phenotypic drug susceptibility testing and whole-genome sequencing.

full_output.paper_title: Exploring the chemical and biological landscape of a Nickel (II) schiff base complex via azomethine linkage.
full_output.key_findings: The study presents a novel Ni(II) Schiff-base complex with strong antibacterial activity against several bacterial strains, including E. coli, K. pneumoniae, and B. subtilis, demonstrating its potential as an antimicrobial agent.
full_output.methodology: Synthesis, spectral characterization, and computational modeling were used to analyze the Ni(II) Schiff-base complex.

full_output.paper_title: Antimicrobial resistance profiling of Salmonella and Escherichia coli isolates from conventional poultry farms in Hossana Town, Central Ethiopia.
full_output.key_findings: The study found high levels of antimicrobial resistance in Salmonella and E. coli O157:H7 isolates from poultry farms in Hossana Town, Central Ethiopia, with resistance to multiple antibiotics including ampicillin, sulfamethoxazole, cefoxitin, and tetracycline.
full_output.methodology: Antimicrobial susceptibility testing using the disc diffusion method.

full_output.paper_title: Environmental exposures associated with the gut microbiome and resistome of pregnant women and children in Northwest Ecuador.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies clinically relevant beta-lactamase genes (bla CTX-M, bla OXA, bla SHV, bla TEM) and other resistance genes (aac(6')-I, aph(6)-I, qnrB1, ermB) in the gut microbiome of pregnant women and children in Ecuador, highlighting the role of environmental and animal exposures in shaping the resistome.
full_output.methodology: Metagenomic sequencing and statistical modeling to analyze the gut resistome and microbiome in relation to environmental and animal exposure factors.

full_output.paper_title: Characterization of broad host range bacteriophages vKpIN31 and vKpIN32 against hospital-acquired Klebsiella pneumoniae in Dakar, Senegal.
full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes two lytic bacteriophages, vKpIN31 and vKpIN32, which effectively target multidrug-resistant (MDR) Klebsiella pneumoniae strains. These phages exhibit broad host ranges, thermal and pH stability, and significant antibiofilm activity. Genomic analysis shows they belong to the Sugarlandvirus genus and lack genes associated with virulence or antimicrobial resistance.
full_output.methodology: Phage isolation, purification, host range analysis, stability testing, in vitro bacteriolytic activity assessment, one-step growth experiments, biofilm disruption evaluation, and whole-genome sequencing with bioinformatics analysis.

full_output.paper_title: Correlation between the antibiotic resistance and virulence determinants of vancomycin-resistant enterococci: paradoxical involvement of vanA in phenotypic resistance to teicoplanin.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified vanA as the primary vancomycin resistance gene in VRE isolates, and explored the correlation between virulence genes (esp, gelE, hyl) and biofilm formation, gelatinase activity, and antibiotic resistance.
full_output.methodology: Phenotypic and genotypic analysis including PCR, sequencing, and susceptibility testing.

full_output.paper_title: Prevalence and characterization of carbapenem-resistant gram-negative bacteria from poultry in Tamil Nadu, India.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified bla NDM-1, bla KPC-3, and bla OXA-48-like carbapenemase genes in various carbapenem-resistant gram-negative bacteria isolated from chicken meat samples in Tamil Nadu, India. These genes were found to confer resistance to meropenem.
full_output.methodology: PCR, Modified Hodge test, whole genome sequencing, and bioinformatics analysis were used to identify and characterize carbapenem-resistant bacteria and their resistance genes.

full_output.key_findings: Jinghuaweikang capsule (JWC) alleviates gastric mucosal inflammation and reduces the abundance of antibiotic resistance genes in H. pylori-infected mice by preserving intestinal microbial diversity and modulating the MAPK signaling pathway.
full_output.methodology: Metagenomic sequencing, ELISA, qRT-PCR, and western blotting were used to assess the effects of JWC on inflammation and antibiotic resistance genes in H. pylori-infected mice.

full_output.paper_title: Transcriptomic Changes in Mycobacterium tuberculosis Under Bedaquiline Stress
full_output.key_findings: The study identified several genes involved in efflux pump and transporter functions that were significantly upregulated in Mycobacterium tuberculosis under bedaquiline (BDQ) stress, suggesting a potential role in BDQ resistance.
full_output.methodology: Transcriptomic analysis using RNA sequencing to examine gene expression changes in BDQ-resistant clinical isolates and H37Rv under BDQ exposure.

full_output.paper_title: Development of a high-throughput screening platform for C. difficile toxin synthesis inhibitors unveils meclizine as an antivirulence agent.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies meclizine as an antivirulence agent that inhibits the biosynthesis of C. difficile toxins TcdA and TcdB without affecting bacterial growth. It also shows that meclizine alters carbohydrate metabolism, increasing intracellular glucose and pyruvate levels, which are known to suppress toxin production.
full_output.methodology: High-throughput screening using a C. difficile reporter strain expressing secreted Nano-luciferase under the tcdA promoter, followed by dose-response assays and transcriptomic analysis.

full_output.paper_title: Staphylococcus aureus in commercial laying hens from Pernambuco, Brazil: detection of efflux pumps and β-lactam resistance genes.
full_output.key_findings: The study detected β-lactam resistance gene blaZ and methicillin resistance gene mecC, along with efflux pump genes norA, norC, and msrA in Staphylococcus aureus isolates from commercial laying hens in Brazil.
full_output.methodology: PCR detection of AMR genes in S. aureus isolates from poultry samples.

full_output.paper_title: Development of a LAMP assay using hybridization-based TaqMan-style probes (HyTaq) for simultaneous detection of wild-type and macrolide-resistant Mycoplasma pneumoniae.

23S rRNA.mechanism: point mutations leading to macrolide resistance

full_output.key_findings: The study developed a LAMP assay using hybridization-based TaqMan-style probes (HyTaq) for the simultaneous detection of wild-type and macrolide-resistant Mycoplasma pneumoniae, focusing on the A2063G and A2064G mutations in the 23S rRNA gene.
full_output.methodology: The MP-R HyTaq-LAMP assay was developed and validated using plasmid standards and clinical samples, with confirmation of genetic mutations via DNA sequencing.

full_output.paper_title: Veterinary method evaluation of Vitek-2 compact for antimicrobial susceptibility testing of Staphylococcus spp. and Enterococcus spp.
full_output.key_findings: The study evaluated the Vitek-2 Compact for antimicrobial susceptibility testing of Staphylococcus and Enterococcus species, highlighting performance issues with certain antimicrobials like clindamycin, minocycline, and β-lactams, emphasizing the need for confirmatory testing and updated panels.
full_output.methodology: The study compared the Vitek-2 Compact with the Sensititre COMPGP1F system using MIC testing and evaluated categorical and essential agreements.
full_output.sample_size: 51 Staphylococcus spp. not aureus/lugdunensis, 30 Staphylococcus aureus and Staphylococcus lugdunensis, and 34 Enterococcus spp.

full_output.paper_title: Tetracycline Resistance Among Neisseria gonorrhoeae Isolates-United States, 1987-2022.
full_output.key_findings: The study found that tetracycline resistance (TetR) among Neisseria gonorrhoeae isolates has remained stable, but high-level tetracycline resistance (TetHLR) has increased significantly over time, especially among men who have sex with men (MSM).
full_output.methodology: The study analyzed tetracycline resistance patterns in Neisseria gonorrhoeae isolates collected through national surveillance programs in the United States from 1987 to 2022.
full_output.sample_size: 183,668 urethral GC isolates from 1987-2022 and 38,383 GC isolates from 2018-2022

full_output.paper_title: Impacts of COVID-19 pandemic on early life gut microbiome.
full_output.key_findings: The study found that the gut microbiome diversity, composition, and developmental trajectory were significantly altered between pre- and during-COVID-19 cohorts. Specifically, Staphylococcus epidermidis carried a lower copy number of fluoroquinolone and beta-lactam antibiotics resistance genes, while Klebsiella pneumoniae possessed a higher copy number of fluoroquinolone antibiotic resistance genes in the during-COVID cohort.
full_output.methodology: Shotgun metagenomics sequencing and comparative analysis of gut microbiome composition and functional pathways between pre- and during-COVID-19 cohorts.

full_output.paper_title: Association of D516V, H526Y, and S531L rpoB gene polymorphisms and risk factors with rifampicin resistance in Mycobacterium tuberculosis isolates from pulmonary TB patients in Northwest Amhara, Ethiopia: cross-sectional study.

rpoB.notes: Mutation detected via ARMS-PCR.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified D516V, H526Y, and S531L mutations in the rpoB gene associated with rifampicin resistance in Mycobacterium tuberculosis isolates.
full_output.methodology: ARMS-PCR was used to detect rpoB gene mutations in MTB isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Antimicrobial resistance and virulence gene profiles of Enterococcus faecalis and Enterococcus faecium isolated from subclinical bovine mastitis milk and cow dung.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified vanA, tetM, ermB, vanB, and tetK as the main antimicrobial resistance genes in Enterococcus faecalis and Enterococcus faecium isolates from subclinical bovine mastitis milk and cow dung samples.
full_output.methodology: PCR, MALDI-TOF-MS, and antimicrobial susceptibility testing were used to characterize the resistance and virulence profiles of the isolates.
full_output.sample_size: 174 milk samples and 68 cow dung samples

full_output.paper_title: One health perspective of antibiotic resistance in enterobacterales from Southeast Asia: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies bla CTX-M and bla TEM as common resistance genes across various sectors in Southeast Asia, along with tet A being prevalent in animal and food sectors. It highlights the high prevalence of resistance to third-generation cephalosporins and tetracyclines.
full_output.methodology: Systematic review and meta-analysis of 137 observational studies from 2013 to 2023.

full_output.paper_title: Nanopore sequencing reveals operon-specific ribosome remodeling accompanying naphthyridone resistance in Staphylococcus aureus.

23S rRNA.mechanism: mutation in rRNA gene leading to resistance
23S rRNA.validation_method: genomic DNA sequencing and nanopore sequencing

mutations_found.validated_by: genomic DNA sequencing and nanopore sequencing

23S rRNA.notes: The mutation is located in operon 2 and is associated with resistance to naphthyridone antibiotics.

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies a single 23S rRNA mutation (T1732C) in operon 2 of Staphylococcus aureus that confers resistance to the naphthyridone antibiotic A-692345.
full_output.methodology: Genomic DNA and RNA nanopore sequencing were used to analyze resistance mechanisms in Staphylococcus aureus.

full_output.paper_title: Strain-dependent contribution of the AcrAB-TolC efflux pump to Klebsiella pneumoniae physiology.

ramR.notes: Inactivation of ramR leads to overexpression of acrAB-TolC and reduced susceptibility to certain antibiotics.

full_output.key_findings: Deletion of acrB in K. pneumoniae Ecl8 and ATCC 43816 resulted in increased susceptibility to several antibiotics, while deletion of ramR led to overexpression of acrAB-TolC and reduced susceptibility. The AcrAB-TolC efflux pump contributes to antimicrobial resistance and virulence in a strain-dependent manner.
full_output.methodology: Generation of isogenic deletion mutants, antimicrobial susceptibility testing, biofilm assays, and virulence assessments in Galleria mellonella.

full_output.paper_title: Pulsed antibiotic release into the environment may foster the spread of antimicrobial resistance.
full_output.key_findings: This study develops a mathematical model to simulate antibiotic accumulation in aquatic systems and evaluates its influence on the selection of resistant bacterial strains. It highlights how pulsed antibiotic release can drive the selection of resistant strains, especially when antibiotics interact synergistically, even at concentrations below their individual minimum selective concentrations.
full_output.methodology: The study uses a mathematical model based on ordinary differential equations to simulate microbial competition, antibiotic effects, and resistance dynamics under various environmental conditions.

full_output.paper_title: Whole genome sequencing and genomic characterization of the extensively drug-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii recovered from clinical samples in Lahore, Pakistan.

blaOXA-69.evidence_note: blaOXA-69 was identified in the genome of the XDR A. baumannii isolate TAB-4.

blaADC-25.evidence_note: The paper mentions blaADC-25 as a major resistant determinant in the XDR Acinetobacter baumannii strain TAB-4.

full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes the extensive drug-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii strain TAB-4, identifying several beta-lactamase genes (blaOXA-23, blaOXA-69, blaNDM-1, blaADC-25) and efflux pump systems (adeABC, adeFGH, adeIJK) as key contributors to its multidrug resistance.
full_output.methodology: Whole genome sequencing and in-silico genome analysis were used to identify resistance genes, virulence factors, and mobile genetic elements in the XDR A. baumannii strain TAB-4.
full_output.sample_size: 11 A. baumannii isolates, including one XDR strain (TAB-4)

full_output.paper_title: Hermetia illucens chitosan: indirect and direct antimicrobial activity of an innovative biopolymer for clinical and pharmaceutical applications.
full_output.key_findings: The study evaluated the indirect and direct antimicrobial activity of chitosan from Hermetia illucens, demonstrating its ability to upregulate HBD-2 expression and inhibit the growth of Gram-positive bacteria such as Enterococcus faecalis, Staphylococcus epidermidis, and Streptococcus agalactiae.
full_output.methodology: The study used microdilution assays and qPCR to evaluate the antimicrobial activity of chitosan from H. illucens on various bacterial strains.

full_output.paper_title: Zinc pyrithione impairs iron-sulfur cluster biogenesis in Mycobacterium tuberculosis.

Rv1466.genetic_context: upregulated in response to ZnPT treatment
Rv1466.evidence_note: The SUF operon (Rv1460-Rv1466) was markedly upregulated at 4 h, likely due to ZnPT-induced copper accumulation disrupting Fe-S cluster homeostasis.

full_output.key_findings: ZnPT impairs iron-sulfur cluster biogenesis in Mycobacterium tuberculosis, leading to metabolic paralysis and bioenergetic collapse.
full_output.methodology: Transcriptomic analysis, enzyme activity assays, and metabolomic profiling were used to evaluate the effects of ZnPT on Mtb.

full_output.paper_title: Genomic and functional characterization of a novel lytic phage vB-AbaM-fThrA with anti-biofilm activity against CR-MDR Acinetobacter baumannii.
full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes a novel lytic phage, fThrA, with anti-biofilm activity against CR-MDR Acinetobacter baumannii. The phage exhibits a broad host range, effective biofilm disruption, and stability under various environmental conditions.
full_output.methodology: Genomic sequencing, biofilm assays, and phage stability tests were conducted to characterize the phage fThrA.

full_output.paper_title: Genomic epidemiology of antimicrobial resistance in Proteus mirabilis: core genome and plasmid-mediated drivers.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified 197 AMR gene subtypes in Proteus mirabilis, including beta-lactamases (bla TEM-1, bla CTX-M-15, bla NDM-1), aminoglycoside-modifying enzymes (aac(6')-Ib-cr, aph(3'')-Ib), and other resistance determinants. Plasmids, particularly IncC plasmids, were found to be major carriers of these genes, contributing to the spread of multidrug resistance.
full_output.methodology: Genomic analysis of 2,013 P. mirabilis genomes, including 1,990 publicly available strains and 23 newly sequenced clinical isolates, using bioinformatics tools to identify AMR genes and plasmid-mediated resistance mechanisms.

full_output.paper_title: Prevalence and antimicrobial susceptibility of multi drug-resistant bacteria isolates in adult intensive care units: a six-year retrospective study from a tertiary hospital in Mogadishu, Somalia.
full_output.key_findings: The study highlights the high prevalence of multidrug-resistant (MDR) bacteria in adult intensive care units (ICUs) in Mogadishu, Somalia, with a focus on carbapenem-resistant Klebsiella and Acinetobacter species. It emphasizes the urgent need for antimicrobial stewardship and improved infection control measures.
full_output.methodology: Retrospective analysis of bacterial isolates from ICU patients over six years, including antimicrobial susceptibility testing using disk diffusion and E-test methods.

full_output.paper_title: Target gene mutation discovery and amplicon sequencing for evaluating maduramicin resistance in Eimeria tenella.

ETH2_0402100.validation_method: CRISPR/Cas9-mediated site-directed mutagenesis and gene overexpression

mutations_found.validated_by: PCR amplification, Sanger sequencing, CRISPR/Cas9-mediated site-directed mutagenesis, and gene overexpression

ETH2_0402100.notes: The c.1255 C > T mutation in the ETH2_0402100 gene results in a leucine-to-phenylalanine substitution, which confers maduramicin resistance.

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies a single nucleotide mutation (c.1255 C > T) in the ETH2_0402100 gene of Eimeria tenella that confers resistance to maduramicin. This mutation was validated through CRISPR/Cas9-mediated site-directed mutagenesis and gene overexpression.
full_output.methodology: Genetic crossing, QTL-seq, CRISPR/Cas9-mediated site-directed mutagenesis, gene overexpression, and amplicon sequencing were used to identify and validate the mutation in ETH2_0402100.

full_output.paper_title: Gut microbiome profiling of a migratory Anser serrirostris population reveals two groups with distinct pathogen and ARG contents.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified two distinct gut microbiome groups (E1 and E2) in a migratory Anser serrirostris population, with E1 showing higher abundances of opportunistic pathogens and antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs). Key ARGs included beta-lactamase-encoding genes such as blaCTX-M, blaZ, blaCARB-1, blaADC, blaPDC, and blaOXA-213, which were more prevalent in E1.
full_output.methodology: Full-length 16S rDNA sequencing and metagenomic analysis were used to characterize the gut microbiome and identify ARGs.

full_output.paper_title: Quantifying the bystander effect of antimicrobial use on the gut microbiome and resistome in Malawian adults.
full_output.key_findings: Ceftriaxone exposure is associated with increased prevalence of aminoglycoside and macrolide resistance genes in the gut microbiome of Malawian adults, particularly in Escherichia coli.
full_output.methodology: Shotgun metagenomic sequencing and Bayesian regression models were used to analyze the gut microbiome and resistome changes following antimicrobial exposure.

full_output.paper_title: Design, Synthesis, and Evaluation of β‑Lactamase Inhibitors as Potential Therapeutics for Antimicrobial Resistance.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies compounds 3g and 6a as effective β-lactamase inhibitors, demonstrating significant inhibition of β-lactamase activity and synergistic effects when combined with imipenem against clinical isolates of S. aureus.
full_output.methodology: Synthesis of thienopyrimidine derivatives, antibacterial assays, β-lactamase activity assays, and molecular docking studies.

full_output.paper_title: Colanic acid-mediated phage resistance enhances virulence in high-risk global clone Escherichia coli ST410.

mutations_found.validated_by: whole-genome sequencing, phage adsorption efficiency, complementation with wild-type yrfF
Inactivation leads to constitutive activation of the Rcs system, triggering overexpression of the cps operon and colanic acid hyperproduction

yrfF.notes: The yrfF T292A mutation promotes colanic acid overproduction, impairing phage adsorption.

mutations_found.validated_by: whole-genome sequencing, phage adsorption efficiency, complementation with wild-type lon
Complementation with wild-type lon fully abolished the mucoid phenotype, reduced colanic acid production and phage sensitivity

lon.notes: The lon Glu93Ter mutation prevents RcsA degradation, driving unchecked capsule biosynthesis.

full_output.key_findings: The yrfF T292A mutation and lon Glu93Ter mutation lead to colanic acid overproduction, conferring broad phage resistance in E. coli ST410. These mutations enhance immune evasion and virulence, highlighting the risks of phage-resistant variants.
full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing, phage adsorption efficiency assays, complementation experiments, qRT-PCR, and in vivo infection models.

full_output.paper_title: Successful dual therapy of aztreonam and ceftazidime-avibactam for multidrug-resistant Stenotrophomonas maltophilia infection in a preterm neonate: A life-saving approach.
full_output.key_findings: The paper describes the successful use of a combination of ceftazidime-avibactam and aztreonam to treat a multidrug-resistant Stenotrophomonas maltophilia infection in a preterm neonate, highlighting the importance of targeting the intrinsic beta-lactamases L1 and L2.
full_output.methodology: Case report and literature review.

full_output.paper_title: Epidemiology and molecular typing of multidrug resistant Acinetobacter baumannii burn wound isolates from six Chinese provinces.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified multiple AMR genes in multidrug-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii isolates from six Chinese provinces, including beta-lactamases (blaIMP, blaVIM, blaNDM, blaAmpC, blaOXA-58, blaOXA-23, blaOXA-51), permeability defects (carO, omp33-36), and efflux pumps (adeA, adeB, adeC, adeI, adeJ). These genes were associated with resistance to various antibiotics, highlighting the complexity of resistance mechanisms in these isolates.
full_output.methodology: The study used MLST, PCR screening, and antimicrobial susceptibility testing to analyze AMR genes and resistance patterns in A. baumannii isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Phylogenetic and pathogenic description of Enterococcus faecalis at a Northern Chinese hospital.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified lsa(A) as an intrinsic resistance gene in Enterococcus faecalis isolates, conferring resistance to quinupristin/dalfopristin. No vancomycin-resistant genes were found, and the ARG profiles were consistent with antimicrobial susceptibility tests.
full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing (WGS) and antimicrobial susceptibility tests were used to analyze the genetic and phenotypic characteristics of E. faecalis isolates.

full_output.key_findings: Predatory mite treatment increased the abundance of antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs) and virulence factor genes (VFGs) in tea garden soils, with Actinobacteriota and Pseudonocardiaceae being key contributors. The study highlights the role of trophic cascades in shaping microbial communities and influencing ARG/VFG dynamics.
full_output.methodology: Metagenomic analysis, soil microcosm experiments, and statistical modeling were used to investigate the effects of predatory mites on ARGs and VFGs in tea garden soils.

full_output.paper_title: Genomic and phenotypic diversity among taxonomically ambiguous clinical Corynebacterium isolates.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified multiple AMR genes, including erm(X), tet(W), and aminoglycoside modifying enzymes, in various Corynebacterium species, highlighting extensive antimicrobial resistance in clinical isolates.
full_output.methodology: Genome sequencing, biochemical tests, and antimicrobial susceptibility testing were performed to characterize the AMR profiles of the isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Cell wall-inhibiting antibiotics resistance in Streptococcus pneumoniae causing invasive diseases: a global systematic review and meta-analysis in pediatric populations.
full_output.key_findings: The study provides a comprehensive overview of the global status of resistance to anti-cell wall antibiotics among S. pneumoniae strains causing invasive diseases, highlighting the high prevalence of penicillin-non-susceptible pneumococci and varying resistance rates across different regions and antibiotics.
full_output.methodology: A systematic review and meta-analysis were conducted using data from 54 studies published between 1994 and 2022, analyzing resistance rates to cell wall-inhibiting antibiotics in pediatric S. pneumoniae isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Co-selection of genetic antibiotic resistance in Streptococcus pneumoniae after repeated azithromycin mass drug administrations in Niger.
full_output.key_findings: Repeated azithromycin mass drug administrations in Niger led to the co-selection of genetic resistance to macrolides, tetracyclines, and trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole in Streptococcus pneumoniae, primarily mediated by mobile genetic elements.
full_output.methodology: Long-read whole-genome sequencing and phenotypic resistance analysis of Streptococcus pneumoniae isolates from nasopharyngeal samples.

full_output.paper_title: Metabolic potentiation of antibiotic killing by L-arginine in drug-resistant Edwardsiella tarda.
full_output.key_findings: L-arginine enhances the bactericidal activity of chloramphenicol (CAP) against multidrug-resistant Edwardsiella tarda by modulating metabolic pathways, including the TCA cycle and phenylalanine metabolism, leading to increased reactive oxygen species (ROS) and reduced antioxidant capacity.
full_output.methodology: Experiments included bacterial growth assays, metabolomic profiling, enzyme activity assays, and measurement of membrane potential and redox state.

full_output.paper_title: Emergence of coexisting bla(NDM) and mcr-1 genes in Escherichia coli isolates from the guts of healthy individuals.

blaNDM.genetic_context: bla NDM-5 was located in a class 1 integron named In 907 , with a conserved module structure of IS 15-ble MBL - bla NDM-5 -CH -IS Aba125
blaNDM.evidence_note: The paper states that bla NDM and mcr-1 were located on transferable plasmids, and SNP analysis placed the isolates in five distinct clades.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified the coexistence of blaNDM and mcr-1 genes in Escherichia coli isolates from healthy individuals, highlighting the potential for horizontal gene transfer and the need for surveillance.
full_output.methodology: Drug susceptibility testing, whole-genome sequencing, PCR, and phylogenetic analysis were conducted.

full_output.paper_title: A short antimicrobial peptides family demonstrates efficacy to infection via a multimodal mechanism of action.
full_output.key_findings: The study reports the design of a series of antibacterial and antibiofilm short antimicrobial peptides (SAMPs) using rational database-filtering technology. These SAMPs show potent antimicrobial activity against both Gram-negative and Gram-positive bacteria, including multidrug-resistant strains, with no observed resistance development. They exhibit a multimodal mechanism of action, including membrane disruption, induction of apoptosis-like death, and interference with cellular processes.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized database-filtering technology to design SAMPs, followed by in vitro and in vivo evaluations of their antimicrobial activity, stability, and biocompatibility.

full_output.key_findings: The study evaluated the efficacy of cefiderocol (CFDC) in treating ventilator-associated pneumonia (VAP) caused by carbapenem-resistant Pseudomonas aeruginosa (CR-Pa) and Acinetobacter baumannii (CR-Ab) in immunocompromised mice. CFDC showed improved survival and reduced bacterial load in CR-Ab-induced VAP with fT > MIC of 70%, but not in CR-Pa-induced VAP. Higher fT > MIC values (90% and 100%) were required for significant bacterial reduction in CR-Pa.
full_output.methodology: The study used VAP mouse models to assess CFDC's in vivo efficacy, determining dosing regimens based on pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic (PK/PD) principles and evaluating survival, bacterial load, and histopathological changes.

full_output.key_findings: The study shows that micro/nanoplastics (M/NPs) enhance the conjugative transfer of antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs) between bacteria, particularly in systems involving Escherichia coli and Enterococcus faecalis. The 20-nm and 1-μm PS M/NPs significantly facilitated ARG transfer, with the latter showing a stronger effect on E. coli recipients. The mechanism involves increased reactive oxygen species (ROS) production, altered cell membrane permeability, and changes in gene expression related to conjugation.
full_output.methodology: Conjugation experiments, PCR amplification, electrophoresis, and transcriptomic profiling were used to analyze the effect of PS M/NPs on ARG transfer.

full_output.key_findings: The study reports on antimicrobial resistance in Staphylococcus aureus infections related to orthopedics, highlighting the prevalence of methicillin resistance and the effectiveness of certain antimicrobial agents like clindamycin and levofloxacin.
full_output.methodology: The study conducted antimicrobial susceptibility testing using the WALKWAY-96 system and analyzed resistance patterns in 196 patients with S. aureus infections.

full_output.paper_title: Whole genome sequence of Staphylococcus aureus strain 37Â M isolated from cows with subclinical mastitis in Uganda.

blaZ.evidence_note: The paper mentions blaZ as a gene conferring resistance to beta-lactams in the context of the Comprehensive Antibiotic Resistance Database (CARD) screening.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified several AMR genes in Staphylococcus aureus strain 37M, including tetracycline resistance genes (tet(K) and tet(38)), efflux pumps (mepA, norA, LmrS), beta-lactamase (blaZ), and regulatory genes (mepR, arlR, arlS).
full_output.methodology: Genome sequencing and screening using CARD and ResFinder databases.

full_output.key_findings: The study evaluates the effectiveness of the Bruker MALDI Biotyper (MBT) subtyping module in detecting KPC-producing Enterobacterales, highlighting its low sensitivity but high specificity and positive predictive value.
full_output.methodology: The study compared the MBT Module with a laboratory-developed real-time KPC PCR to assess its ability to detect KPC in a variety of clinical and reference Enterobacterales isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Core-shell structured silver-ferrite nanoparticles for antibacterial action and magnetic removal of bacteria from aqueous media.
full_output.key_findings: The study developed core-shell structured silver-ferrite nanoparticles (Ag/CoFe2O4 and Ag/NiFe2O4) with strong antibacterial activity against both Gram-negative (E. coli) and Gram-positive (Micrococcus luteus) bacteria. These nanoparticles demonstrated effective bacterial removal from aqueous solutions, with complete inhibition at low concentrations.
full_output.methodology: Synthesis and characterization of nanoparticles, antibacterial activity testing via agar diffusion and MIC assays, adsorption efficiency evaluation, and time-kill kinetic assays.

full_output.paper_title: In vitro Antibiotic Susceptibility of Bacterial Isolates from Polish patients with Cystic Fibrosis: A Non-Interventional Study.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified high susceptibility of Staphylococcus aureus to tigecycline, linezolid, and vancomycin, and Pseudomonas aeruginosa to colistin and ceftazidime/avibactam. It also highlighted the presence of methicillin-resistant S. aureus and extended-spectrum beta-lactamase-producing strains.
full_output.methodology: The study evaluated the in vitro antimicrobial susceptibility of bacterial isolates from cystic fibrosis patients using EUCAST guidelines.

full_output.paper_title: Genomic characterization and comparative analysis of multidrug-resistant Escherichia coli ST361 from urban wetland.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies multidrug-resistant Escherichia coli ST361 from urban wetlands in India, highlighting the presence of resistance genes such as pmr, tolC, acr, and sul2, which confer resistance to polymyxins, beta-lactams, sulfonamides, and other antibiotics.
full_output.methodology: Whole genome sequencing and antimicrobial susceptibility testing were used to characterize the resistance genes and determine the resistance profile of the isolate.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified high ciprofloxacin non-susceptibility (64.8%) and resistance to aminoglycosides in Salmonella isolates causing invasive disease in Mexico, highlighting the need to revise empirical treatment strategies.
full_output.methodology: Antimicrobial susceptibility testing was conducted using the Kirby-Bauer disk diffusion method or VITEK 2, following CLSI guidelines.

full_output.paper_title: Ciprofloxacin resistance in community and hospital-acquired urinary tract infections: a systematic review and meta-analysis from African population.
full_output.key_findings: This study found a high prevalence of ciprofloxacin resistance among uropathogens in Africa, with an overall rate of 34%. Enterococci showed the highest resistance rate at 47%, while Providencia had the lowest at 18.2%.
full_output.methodology: Systematic review and meta-analysis of studies on ciprofloxacin resistance in uropathogens from Africa.

full_output.paper_title: Mechanistic insights into Rottlerin's inhibition of MrkH-mediated biofilm and capsule formation in Klebsiella pneumoniae.

full_output.key_findings: Rottlerin inhibits biofilm and capsule formation in Klebsiella pneumoniae by targeting MrkH, a c-di-GMP-responsive transcriptional activator, without affecting bacterial growth or viability at sub-MIC levels.
full_output.methodology: Molecular docking, dynamic modeling, and structural analysis were used to evaluate Rottlerin's interaction with MrkH, alongside biofilm and capsule size assessments.

full_output.key_findings: Reducing broad-spectrum antibiotic use in NICUs is associated with a significant decrease in the prevalence of multidrug-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae isolates.
full_output.methodology: Retrospective cohort study analyzing antibiotic resistance patterns of K. pneumoniae isolates from preterm infants in a level 3 NICU between 2013 and 2022.

full_output.key_findings: The study evaluates the impact of different Candida albicans and Staphylococcus aureus strains on biofilm tolerance to antimicrobials and cold atmospheric plasma (CAP). It highlights that C. albicans strains, especially high biofilm-forming ones, confer vancomycin resistance to S. aureus within interkingdom biofilms, and CAP pretreatment enhances antimicrobial efficacy.
full_output.methodology: The study used biofilm formation assays, crystal violet staining, and antimicrobial susceptibility testing to assess biofilm characteristics and resistance mechanisms.

full_output.paper_title: Deciphering the population dynamics and drug-resistance characteristics of extrapulmonary tuberculosis: genomic and clinical insights from a Chinese hospital.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified common resistance-associated mutations in EPTB isolates, including katG Ser315Thr, rpoB Ser450Leu, and mutations in gyrA, which are linked to resistance against isoniazid, rifampicin, and fluoroquinolones, respectively.
full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing and drug susceptibility testing were used to identify AMR genes and mutations in EPTB isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Antibiotic Resistance in the Philippines: Environmental Reservoirs, Spillovers, and One-Health Research Gaps.
full_output.key_findings: The paper highlights the prevalence of antibiotic resistance in the Philippines, focusing on environmental reservoirs and spillovers. It identifies key resistance mechanisms such as bla NDM and bla KPC in hospital sewage and rivers, emphasizing the need for improved surveillance and One-Health approaches.
full_output.methodology: The study reviews published data on antibiotic resistance in clinical, agricultural, and environmental contexts, analyzing resistance trends and mechanisms.

full_output.paper_title: Changing dynamics of antibiotic resistant Escherichia in Caspian gulls shows the importance of longitudinal environmental studies
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies specific AMR genes such as bla CMY-2 and bla CTX-M-1, as well as colicin genes cib and cba, which play roles in the persistence and competitive success of resistant E. coli strains in Caspian gulls.
full_output.methodology: Genomic analysis and sequencing of plasmids and bacterial isolates from Caspian gulls.

full_output.paper_title: Epoxytiglianes potentiate the activity of colistin against resistant Escherichia coli via modification of the bacterial cell membrane.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies mcr-1 and mcr-3 as colistin resistance genes in Enterobacteriaceae, demonstrating that EBC-1013 enhances colistin activity by modifying the bacterial cell membrane.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized molecular dynamics simulations, X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, and permeabilization assays to evaluate the interaction of EBC-1013 with colistin-resistant E. coli.

full_output.paper_title: Molecular epidemiology of drug resistance and transmission of Mycobacterium tuberculosis in Meigu County, Sichuan Province, China.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified several mutations in genes associated with drug resistance in Mycobacterium tuberculosis isolates from Meigu County, Sichuan Province, China. These include mutations in rpoB, katG, inhA, gyrA, rpsL, rrs, embB, and pncA, which confer resistance to rifampicin, isoniazid, fluoroquinolones, streptomycin, aminoglycosides, ethambutol, and pyrazinamide, respectively.
full_output.methodology: The study used DNA microarray chip technology and whole-genome sequencing to detect drug resistance mutations in Mycobacterium tuberculosis isolates.

full_output.paper_title: NDM-63: a novel NDM metallo-β-lactamase variant in the L3 loop, from a Klebsiella pneumoniae clinical isolate.

blaNDM-63.validation_method: expression in E. coli and MIC testing

full_output.key_findings: The study reports a novel NDM variant, NDM-63, identified in a carbapenem-resistant ST147 Klebsiella pneumoniae. NDM-63 exhibits unique sequence alterations in the L3 loop, including G69S, A72H substitutions, and F70 deletion, leading to reduced carbapenem and cefepime resistance compared to NDM-1, but remains susceptible to taniborbactam.
full_output.methodology: Genomic analysis, cloning, expression in E. coli, and antimicrobial susceptibility testing.

full_output.paper_title: Microbiological profile and antibiotic resistance trends of preoperative conjunctival swabs: An 8-year retrospective analysis from a North Indian tertiary care ophthalmic center.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified a high prevalence of coagulase-negative Staphylococci (CoNS) and Corynebacterium species in preoperative conjunctival swabs, with significant methicillin resistance among Staphylococcal isolates. Resistance to fluoroquinolones, macrolides, and tetracyclines was observed, while no vancomycin resistance was detected.
full_output.methodology: Retrospective analysis of conjunctival swab cultures and antibiotic susceptibility testing using the Kirby-Bauer disk diffusion method.

full_output.paper_title: Polymyxin resistance in Gram-negative bacteria: a comprehensive review with a focus on the role of 4-amino-4-deoxy-L-arabinose.
full_output.key_findings: This review discusses the molecular mechanisms of polymyxin resistance in Gram-negative bacteria, focusing on the role of 4-amino-4-deoxy-L-arabinose (l-Ara4N) in modifying lipopolysaccharide (LPS) to reduce susceptibility to polymyxins. Key regulatory systems such as PhoPQ, PmrAB, and CrrAB are highlighted for their involvement in the biosynthesis and attachment of l-Ara4N to LPS.
full_output.methodology: This is a review article summarizing existing literature on polymyxin resistance mechanisms in Gram-negative bacteria.

full_output.paper_title: A lignan compound regulates LPS modifications via PmrA/B signaling cascades to potentiate colistin efficacy in vivo.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies eptA and arnT as critical genes involved in LPS modifications that confer resistance to colistin. MAG potentiates colistin by blocking the expression of eptA and arnT, thus reducing cationic modifications on LPS. The PmrA/B signaling pathway is also involved in regulating these modifications.
full_output.methodology: Mutant analysis, synergy assays, and MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry were used to investigate the role of eptA, arnT, pmrA, and pmrB in colistin resistance.

full_output.paper_title: AI-driven antimicrobial peptide characterization unveils novel motifs for drug design.
full_output.key_findings: The study introduces an AI-driven framework for motif extraction in antimicrobial peptides (AMPs), demonstrating that topic model-derived motifs are more diverse and capture contextual information effectively compared to frequency-based motifs. The research highlights the importance of motif analysis in understanding AMP functionality and designing novel antimicrobial agents.
full_output.methodology: The study employs a topic modeling framework using Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) to extract motifs from AMP sequences, comparing them with frequency-based methods. The analysis involves evaluating physicochemical properties, structural features, and biological relevance of the extracted motifs.

full_output.paper_title: Detection and Preliminary Genomic Characterization of Poultry-Derived Salmonella enterica from Southern Kazakhstan.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified multidrug-resistant Salmonella enterica isolates from poultry farms in southern Kazakhstan, with universal fluoroquinolone resistance and plasmid-borne AMR genes such as blaTEM-116, tet(A), sul1, ant(3")-Ia, and dfrA14.
full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing, conventional PCR, and antimicrobial susceptibility testing were used to characterize AMR genes and mutations in Salmonella enterica isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Cefiderocol as a Successful Therapy for Osteomyelitis Due to XDR Pseudomonas aeruginosa: A Case Report and Literature Review.
full_output.key_findings: The paper reports the successful treatment of a case of chronic osteomyelitis caused by XDR Pseudomonas aeruginosa with cefiderocol. It also provides a literature review of nine case reports showing cefiderocol's efficacy against XDR P. aeruginosa in osteomyelitis.
full_output.methodology: Case report and literature review.

full_output.paper_title: Use of Cefiderocol for Carbapenem-Resistant Gram-Negative Infections in Hospital at Home: Multicentric Real-World Experience.
full_output.key_findings: The study evaluated the use of cefiderocol (CFD) for treating carbapenem-resistant Gram-negative bacterial (GNB) infections in a Hospital at Home (HaH) setting. It found that CFD was effective and safe, with a high clinical success rate and low adverse event rate. The most common pathogens were Pseudomonas aeruginosa and Klebsiella pneumoniae, with resistance mechanisms including VIM, OXA-48, NDM, and ESBL.
full_output.methodology: Retrospective, observational study across six Spanish centers evaluating the feasibility, efficacy, and safety of CFD in HaH programs.

full_output.paper_title: Plasmid-Mediated Spread of Antibiotic Resistance by Arsenic and Microplastics During Vermicomposting.
full_output.key_findings: Arsenic and microplastics significantly influenced the spread of antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs) during vermicomposting, with specific genes like bla ampC, bla LRA-1, bla FEZ-1, aph(3′)-II, ermB, vanY, mefA, catA, tetX4, bla IMP-11, aadK, ant(3′)-Ih-aac(6′)-Id, ermG, bla OXA-119, tetR, vatE, smeE, mexD, bla OXA-3, amrB, tetY, class A beta-lactamase, dfrA1, alanine adenosyltransferase JOHN-1, mdtB, mdtE, and erm-41 being enriched under various treatment conditions.
full_output.methodology: Plasmid metagenomics and experimental validation were used to analyze the effects of arsenic and microplastics on ARG dynamics during vermicomposting.

full_output.paper_title: Antimicrobial Resistance in Selected Enterobacteriaceae from Broilers and Their Environment: ESBL, AmpC, Carbapenemases, Colistin, and Fluoroquinolone Resistance-A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
full_output.key_findings: The study summarizes the prevalence of ESBL, AmpC, carbapenemase, colistin, and fluoroquinolone resistance in Enterobacteriaceae from broilers and their environment, highlighting the significant variation in resistance patterns across regions and sample types.
full_output.methodology: Systematic review and meta-analysis of studies published between 2002 and 2022.

full_output.paper_title: Preliminary Assessment of Arnica montana L. Extract: Antimicrobial Activity Against Acinetobacter baumannii and Biofilm-Related Gene Expression Profiling.

full_output.key_findings: Arnica montana ethanolic extract demonstrated antimicrobial and antibiofilm activities against Acinetobacter baumannii, inhibiting biofilm development by suppressing the transcription of genes involved in pilus assembly and surface adherence.
full_output.methodology: Antimicrobial activity was assessed using broth microdilution, and biofilm formation was evaluated via crystal violet assay. Transcriptional profiling of biofilm-associated genes was conducted via RT-qPCR.

full_output.paper_title: Genomic and Phenotypic Landscape of Antibiotic Resistance in Gut Lactic Acid Bacteria from Livestock Environments.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified multiple antibiotic resistance genes in lactic acid bacteria (LAB) from livestock environments, including van(T), erm(B), cat(A), tet(W), lsa(D), arr, van(Y), and qac(G). These genes conferred resistance to various antibiotics, highlighting the potential for horizontal gene transfer and the importance of monitoring LAB for AMR.
full_output.methodology: Phenotypic antibiotic susceptibility testing and whole-genome sequencing were used to identify and characterize antibiotic resistance genes in LAB isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Characterization of Bacillus velezensis EV17 and K-3618 and Their Polyketide Antibiotic Oxydifficidin, an Inhibitor of Prokaryotic Translation with Low Cytotoxicity.

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies oxydifficidin, a polyketide antibiotic produced by Bacillus velezensis strains EV17 and K-3618, which inhibits prokaryotic translation without affecting eukaryotic translation. The antibiotic shows low cytotoxicity towards eukaryotic cells.
full_output.methodology: Genome sequencing, comparative genomics, and biochemical assays were used to characterize the antibiotic and its mechanism of action.

full_output.paper_title: Heteroaryl Bishydrazono Nitroimidazoles: A Unique Structural Skeleton with Potent Multitargeting Antibacterial Activity.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified compound 4, a heteroaryl bishydrazono nitroimidazole, as a potent antibacterial agent with broad-spectrum activity against both Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria, including MRSA. It exhibits low cytotoxicity and hemolysis, reduces bacterial resistance, and disrupts biofilms.
full_output.methodology: The antibacterial activity of synthesized compounds was evaluated using broth microdilution method, and the mechanism of action was studied through various assays including ROS measurement, DNA interaction, and membrane permeability tests.

full_output.paper_title: Synthesis and Evaluation of Novel 2-((1H-1,2,4-triazol-5-yl)thio)-N-benzylidene-N-phenylacetohydrazide as Potential Antimicrobial Agents.
full_output.key_findings: The study reports the synthesis and evaluation of novel 2-((1H-1,2,4-triazol-5-yl)thio)-N-benzylidene-N-phenylacetohydrazide derivatives as potential antimicrobial agents. Compound 4g showed the most significant antibacterial activity against both Gram-negative (Klebsiella aerogenes) and Gram-positive (Enterococcus sp.) bacteria, with low OD600 readings and a substantial reduction in viable bacterial counts. However, no specific AMR genes or mutations were characterized in this paper.
full_output.methodology: The compounds were synthesized via nucleophilic substitution and characterized using NMR and mass spectrometry. Antimicrobial activity was evaluated using growth kinetics and CFU assays, while cytotoxicity was assessed using MTT assays on HEK cells.

full_output.paper_title: Eco-Friendly Activation of Silicone Surfaces and Antimicrobial Coating with Chitosan Biopolymer.
full_output.key_findings: The study introduces an eco-friendly method for activating silicone surfaces using ethanolamine (ETA) and 1,3-diaminopropane (DAP), followed by chitosan coating to enhance antibacterial properties. The activated surfaces showed stable amino group concentrations and significantly reduced bacterial colony-forming units.
full_output.methodology: Surface activation of silicone with ETA and DAP, followed by chitosan coating and evaluation of antibacterial activity using the drop plate method.

full_output.paper_title: Antimicrobial Resistance Study of Quaternary Ammonium Compounds
full_output.key_findings: The study evaluated the synergistic and additive effects of quaternary ammonium compound (QAC)-based biocide compositions against bacterial and fungal strains, focusing on their antimicrobial activity and resistance profiles.
full_output.methodology: The study involved microbiological analysis of QAC-based compositions, checkerboard assays, time-killing kinetics, and resistance selection experiments.

full_output.paper_title: Genetic Profiling of MRSA and MSSA from Food Contact Surfaces: Antibiotic, Heavy Metal and Benzalkonium Chloride Resistance.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified several AMR genes in S. aureus strains from food contact surfaces, including blaZ, tetM, ermB, ermC, ermA, and aacA-aphD, which confer resistance to penicillin, tetracycline, erythromycin, and gentamicin.
full_output.methodology: PCR and antimicrobial susceptibility testing were used to identify AMR genes and assess resistance profiles in S. aureus isolates.

full_output.key_findings: The study found that high-dose daptomycin monotherapy was more effective than combination therapies in reducing bacterial load in a rat model of daptomycin-resistant Enterococcus faecium endocarditis.
full_output.methodology: The study used a rat model of infective endocarditis to evaluate the efficacy of different antibiotic regimens against a daptomycin-resistant Enterococcus faecium isolate.

full_output.paper_title: Genomic insights into the expansion of meropenem-resistant GPSC1-CC320 Streptococcus pneumoniae serotype 19A isolates from children under 5 years of age with invasive infections, 2018-2024.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies the presence of tet(M), erm(B), mef(A), and msr(D) genes in meropenem-resistant Streptococcus pneumoniae serotype 19A isolates, which confer resistance to tetracycline, erythromycin, and azithromycin. These isolates also exhibit a unique combination of pbp alleles (pbp1a-13, pbp2b-11, pbp2x-16) that contributes to their resistance profile.
full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing and antimicrobial susceptibility testing were used to identify resistance mechanisms in the isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Clonal Diversity and Resistome Dynamics of Acinetobacter baumannii Isolates from Lithuanian National Cancer Center.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified several AMR genes in Acinetobacter baumannii isolates from a Lithuanian cancer center, including blaOXA-23-like, blaOXA-24-like, blaTEM, aacC1, aacC2, aphA6, strA-strB, armA, and sul1. These genes were associated with resistance to carbapenems, beta-lactams, aminoglycosides, and sulfamethoxazole.
full_output.methodology: PCR, genotyping, and antimicrobial susceptibility testing were used to identify AMR genes and determine resistance profiles.

full_output.paper_title: Resistance of Gram-Negative Bacteria to Eravacycline: A Systematic Review of Data from In Vitro Studies.
full_output.key_findings: The systematic review analyzed the resistance of Gram-negative bacteria to eravacycline, highlighting varying resistance rates among different bacterial species and the impact of β-lactamase genes on resistance profiles.
full_output.methodology: Systematic review of in vitro studies assessing eravacycline resistance in Gram-negative bacteria.

full_output.key_findings: The study found that clarithromycin MICs ≥ 64 mg/L and ethambutol MICs > 16 mg/L were associated with increased risk of treatment failure in patients with MAC-PD receiving standard regimens.
full_output.methodology: Retrospective cohort study analyzing the association between antimicrobial susceptibility testing results and treatment outcomes in patients with MAC-PD.

full_output.paper_title: Retrospective Evaluation of the Incidence, Clinical Characteristics and Outcomes of Gram-Negative Bacterial Infections in Patients with Hematologic Malignancies.
full_output.key_findings: The study highlights the high incidence of Gram-negative bacterial bloodstream infections in patients with hematologic malignancies, with Escherichia coli being the most frequently isolated pathogen. It identifies extended-spectrum beta-lactamase-producing/third-generation cephalosporin-resistant (ESBL/3GCR) and carbapenem-resistant isolates as significant contributors to mortality.
full_output.methodology: A retrospective cohort study analyzing data from patients with hematologic malignancies who had Gram-negative bacterial bloodstream infections, focusing on resistance patterns and clinical outcomes.

full_output.paper_title: Characterisation of a Novel Pseudomonas Phage and Its Effect on the Survival of Galleria mellonella Larvae.
full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes two novel Pseudomonas phages, vB_PaMB13 and vB_PaMB17, which show synergistic effects with antibiotics ceftazidime and tobramycin against multi-drug-resistant P. aeruginosa. The phages demonstrate significant in vivo efficacy in a Galleria mellonella model, enhancing survival rates when combined with antibiotics.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized phage isolation, host range analysis, transmission electron microscopy, one-step growth curve analysis, whole-genome sequencing, checkerboard assay, and in vivo efficacy testing in Galleria mellonella larvae.

full_output.paper_title: Epidemiology and Antimicrobial Resistance of Uropathogens in a Tertiary Care Center in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia: A One-Year Retrospective Analysis.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified a high prevalence of extended-spectrum beta-lactamase (ESBL)-producing Enterobacterales, with 28.5% of E. coli and Klebsiella isolates exhibiting ESBL production. ESBL producers showed complete resistance to third-generation cephalosporins and beta-lactam/beta-lactamase inhibitor combinations, while carbapenems, aminoglycosides, and fosfomycin remained effective. Resistance to ciprofloxacin and co-trimoxazole was widespread in both ESBL and non-ESBL isolates.
full_output.methodology: Retrospective analysis of 19,556 urine cultures, with bacterial identification and antimicrobial susceptibility testing using the Vitek 2 system and confirmatory tests such as double-disc synergy test and disk diffusion.

full_output.paper_title: Prevalence of ESBL-Producing Escherichia coli on Neck Skin in Slaughtered Broilers Raised on Conventional, Antibiotic-Free, and Organic Farms.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified various ESBL and AmpC genes, including bla CTX-M-1, bla CTX-M-9, bla TEM, bla SHV, bla OXA, bla CIT, bla MOX, bla DHA, bla ACC, bla EBC, and bla FOX, in ESBL-producing E. coli isolates from broiler neck skin. These genes were associated with resistance to beta-lactam antibiotics such as cefotaxime, ceftazidime, and cefoxitin.
full_output.methodology: The study used PCR and MIC testing to identify and characterize ESBL and AmpC genes in E. coli isolates from broiler neck skin samples.

full_output.paper_title: From Methylomes to CRISPR Epigenetic Editing: New Paths in Antibiotic Resistance.
full_output.key_findings: This review discusses the role of epigenetic mechanisms, such as DNA and RNA methylation, in bacterial and fungal antibiotic resistance, emphasizing the potential of CRISPR-based epigenetic editing to reverse resistance.
full_output.methodology: Review of literature on epigenetic mechanisms and CRISPR-based editing in antibiotic resistance.

full_output.paper_title: Antimicrobial and Antioxidant Activities of Nigella sativa Extracts
full_output.key_findings: The study evaluated the antimicrobial and antioxidant activities of Nigella sativa extracts obtained through different methods, highlighting their effectiveness against a range of microorganisms.
full_output.methodology: Extraction methods included Soxhlet, ultrasound, and supercritical CO2, with antimicrobial activity assessed using microdilution assays.

full_output.paper_title: Virulence Gene Profiles of Extended-Spectrum β-Lactamase (ESBL)-Producing Escherichia coli Isolated from Turkeys in Hungary: A Whole-Genome Sequencing Study.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified ESBL-producing E. coli strains from turkeys carrying various virulence genes, including those associated with adhesion, biofilm formation, and iron acquisition, highlighting their potential to cause disease and resist treatment.
full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing was used to analyze the virulence gene profiles of 160 ESBL-producing E. coli isolates from turkeys.

full_output.paper_title: Prevalence, antimicrobial resistance, and extended-spectrum β-lactamase gene profiles of Escherichia coli isolated from poultry eggshells in Can Tho City, Vietnam.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified bla CTX-M, bla TEM, and bla NDM genes in ESBL-producing E. coli isolates from poultry eggshells in Can Tho City, Vietnam, highlighting the prevalence of multidrug-resistant strains and the potential for resistance gene dissemination through the food chain.
full_output.methodology: PCR, disk diffusion, and antimicrobial susceptibility testing were used to identify ESBL-producing E. coli and characterize their resistance profiles.

ndm.validation_method: genomic analysis and detection in clinical isolates

full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes the molecular epidemiology of Providencia stuartii, identifying multiple carbapenemase genes such as ndm-1 and ndm-7, along with intrinsic resistance genes like aac(2')-Ia, tet(B), and catA3, highlighting the significant antimicrobial resistance profile of this pathogen.
full_output.methodology: Genome sequencing, MLST analysis, and bioinformatics tools were used to characterize the resistome and molecular epidemiology of P. stuartii.

full_output.paper_title: Slaughterhouse Wastewater as a Reservoir of Thermotolerant E. coli With Antimicrobial Resistance and Virulence Potential in Dhaka, Bangladesh.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified several AMR genes in E. coli isolates from slaughterhouse wastewater, including blaTEM, blaCTX-M-15, blaIMP-1, blaIMP-4, blaOXA-48, dfrA17, tetA, sul2, and qnrS, highlighting the presence of multidrug-resistant strains.
full_output.methodology: PCR, phenotypic testing, and biofilm formation assays were used to identify AMR genes and evaluate resistance profiles in E. coli isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Impact of Xpert(®) Carba-R-based screening for carbapenem-resistant organisms on infection-related mortality in hematopoietic stem cell transplant recipients.
full_output.key_findings: The study found that NDM carbapenemase genes were the most frequently detected carbapenem-resistant genes in CRO gut colonization among HSCT patients, highlighting the importance of rapid detection methods like Xpert Carba-R for improving infection control and reducing mortality.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized Xpert Carba-R assay for rapid detection of carbapenemase genes and compared outcomes between historical and study groups.

full_output.paper_title: Scymicrosin(7-26), a Scylla paramamosain-derived novel antimicrobial peptide, exhibits efficacy against multidrug-resistant ESKAPE pathogens and anti-inflammatory activity.
full_output.key_findings: Scymicrosin 7-26 is a novel antimicrobial peptide derived from Scylla paramamosain that shows efficacy against multidrug-resistant ESKAPE pathogens and possesses anti-inflammatory properties.
full_output.methodology: Antimicrobial susceptibility testing, biofilm formation inhibition, and molecular mechanism investigations were conducted.

full_output.paper_title: Emergence of KPC-2 and NDM-13-coproducing carbapenem-resistant hypervirulent Klebsiella pneumoniae with high-risk sequence type ST11.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies a clinical strain of ST11-K64 CR-hvKP co-producing KPC-2 and NDM-13, which carries multiple resistance genes on two plasmids, leading to near-pan-drug resistance.
full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing, PCR, Sanger sequencing, conjugation assays, and antimicrobial susceptibility testing.

full_output.paper_title: In-host co-colonization and bloodstream infection by distinct classical and hypervirulent CRKP clones harboring a homologous bla (KPC-2)-harboring plasmid.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies two distinct CRKP clones, ST268 and ST4496, both harboring the blaKPC-2 gene, which confers carbapenem resistance. The ST268 clone also carries a pK2044-like plasmid, contributing to its hypervirulent phenotype.
full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing, plasmid analysis, and mouse infection models were used to characterize the resistance and virulence profiles of the isolates.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified a single-nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) A2063G in the rrl gene, which is associated with high-level macrolide resistance in Mycoplasma pneumoniae during the 2024-2025 outbreak in Hamilton, Ontario, Canada.
full_output.methodology: PCR genotyping and sequencing of the RepMP4 region of the P1 cytadhesin gene.

full_output.paper_title: Efflux pump-associated antimicrobial resistance genes in Staphylococcus spp. from dairy and meat samples.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified several efflux pump-associated antimicrobial resistance genes in Staphylococcus spp. from dairy and meat samples, including smr, efrA, efrB, mdeA, norE, tetK, bla, and mecA. These genes were found to confer resistance to tetracycline, cefuroxime, and ampicillin.
full_output.methodology: Real-time PCR and MIC testing were used to detect and characterize antimicrobial resistance genes and efflux pump activity in Staphylococcus isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Cyclic Amide-Linked Oxazolidinone Triazoles as Inhibitors of the T-Box Riboswitch.
full_output.key_findings: The study investigated cyclic amide-linked oxazolidinone triazoles as inhibitors of the T-box riboswitch, focusing on their ability to interfere with tRNA-induced transcription readthrough. Compounds 3a, 3i, 3j, and 3l showed inhibition of tRNA-induced transcription readthrough, with 3a demonstrating the highest inhibition (14%). Computational docking suggested that 3a interacts with the A1 helix of the antiterminator region, potentially disrupting the tRNA-antiterminator complex.
full_output.methodology: The study employed fluorescence-monitored transcription assays and computational docking to evaluate the effects of synthesized compounds on T-box riboswitch function.

full_output.paper_title: Phytochemical Evaluation of Terminalia catappa L. Extracts with Antibacterial and Antibiotic Potentiation Activities Against β-Lactam Drug-Resistant Bacteria.
full_output.key_findings: The study evaluates the antibacterial and antibiotic potentiating activities of Terminalia catappa L. extracts against β-lactam drug-resistant bacteria, identifying flavonoids and tannins as potential antibacterial agents.
full_output.methodology: The study used agar diffusion, broth micro-dilution, and LC-MS analyses to evaluate the antibacterial activity of T. catappa extracts and identify their phytochemical components.

full_output.paper_title: Prophage φEr670 and Genomic Island GI_Er147 as Carriers of Resistance Genes in Erysipelothrix rhusiopathiae Strains.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies the prophage φEr670 carrying lnuB and lsaE genes, and the genomic island GI_Er147 carrying ant(6)-Ia, spw, lnu(J), and vat family genes in E. rhusiopathiae strains. These genes confer resistance to lincomycin, tetracycline, streptomycin, and spectinomycin.
full_output.methodology: Nanopore whole genome sequencing, MLST profiling, and antimicrobial susceptibility testing.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified nine clinically important antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs) in wastewater samples from Dhaka and Cox's Bazar, Bangladesh. The most prevalent ARGs were blaTEM, blaCTX-M, blaOXA, tolC, and acrA, with blaKPC and blaNDM also being frequently detected. full_output.paper_title: Selective eradication of pathogenic bacteria using amine-modified corn-straw carbon dots.
full_output.key_findings: The study demonstrates that amine-modified carbon dots (CDs) derived from corn straw selectively eliminate Staphylococcus aureus without affecting beneficial bacteria like Bacillus subtilis. The CDs exhibit intrinsic oxidase-like activity, generating reactive oxygen species (ROS) that disrupt bacterial cell membranes and lead to cell death.
full_output.methodology: The study synthesized amine-modified CDs using a hydrothermal method and evaluated their antibacterial activity against S. aureus and other bacteria using microbiological assays, imaging techniques, and ROS detection methods.

full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing, ANI analysis, phylogenetic analysis, and counterfactual prediction method.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified high levels of antimicrobial resistance in Escherichia coli and Staphylococcus aureus bloodstream isolates from a Cambodian hospital, with 74% of E. coli isolates showing resistance to ceftriaxone and 32% of S. aureus isolates showing methicillin resistance.
full_output.methodology: Antibiotic susceptibility testing was performed using disk diffusion and Etest minimum inhibitory concentration measurements according to CLSI guidelines.

full_output.paper_title: Sustainable, scalable nanotechnology approach using filtrate from Raphanus sativus in combating multidrug-resistant pathogens and causing neglected tropical diseases.
full_output.key_findings: The study demonstrates the synthesis of silver nanoparticles (AgNPs) using radish root filtrate, which exhibits potent antibacterial activity against multidrug-resistant S. aureus and E. coli. The AgNPs disrupt bacterial membrane integrity, cause oxidative damage, and effectively inhibit bacterial growth.
full_output.methodology: Silver nanoparticles were synthesized using radish root filtrate and characterized using UV-vis spectroscopy, XRD, TEM, and FTIR. Antimicrobial activity was assessed through MIC and MBC assays, and bacterial membrane disruption was evaluated using BCA protein assay and FE-SEM.
